exports.KING_ATTACKS = new Array(64);

function msb(bb) {
    if (bb.hi) {
        let x = bb.hi >>> 0;
        let n = 32;
        if (x >= 0x10000) {
            n += 16;
            x >>>= 16;
        }
        if (x >= 0x100) {
            n += 8;
            x >>>= 8;
        }
        if (x >= 0x10) {
            n += 4;
            x >>>= 4;
        }
        if (x >= 0x4) {
            n += 2;
            x >>>= 2;
        }
        if (x >= 0x2) {
            n += 1;
        }
        return n;
    }
    if (bb.lo) {
        let x = bb.lo >>> 0;
        let n = 0;
        if (x >= 0x10000) {
            n += 16;
            x >>>= 16;
        }
        if (x >= 0x100) {
            n += 8;
            x >>>= 8;
        }
        if (x >= 0x10) {
            n += 4;
            x >>>= 4;
        }
        if (x >= 0x4) {
            n += 2;
            x >>>= 2;
        }
        if (x >= 0x2) {
            n += 1;
        }
        return n;
    }
    return -1;
}
function initAttacks() {
    for (let s = 0; s < 64; s++) {
        const b = (0, bitboard_1.bit)(s);
        // Knight: deltas ±17,±15,±10,±6 with file masks
        // Rebuild via square arithmetic for correctness (init-only)
        let kn = (0, bitboard_1.emptyBB)();
        const deltas = [
            [1, 2], [-1, 2], [2, 1], [-2, 1],
            [1, -2], [-1, -2], [2, -1], [-2, -1],
        ];
        const f0 = s & 7, r0 = s >> 3;
        for (const [df, dr] of deltas) {
            const f = f0 + df, r = r0 + dr;
            if (f >= 0 && f < 8 && r >= 0 && r < 8) {
                const t = r * 8 + f;
                if (t < 32)
                    kn.lo = (kn.lo | (1 << t)) >>> 0;
                else
                    kn.hi = (kn.hi | (1 << (t - 32))) >>> 0;
            }
        }
        exports.KNIGHT_ATTACKS[s] = kn;
        exports.KING_ATTACKS[s] = (0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.north)(b), (0, bitboard_1.south)(b)), (0, bitboard_1.east)(b)), (0, bitboard_1.west)(b)), (0, bitboard_1.ne)(b)), (0, bitboard_1.nw)(b)), (0, bitboard_1.se)(b)), (0, bitboard_1.sw)(b));
        exports.WHITE_PAWN_ATTACKS[s] = (0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.ne)(b), (0, bitboard_1.nw)(b));
        exports.BLACK_PAWN_ATTACKS[s] = (0, bitboard_1.or)((0, bitboard_1.se)(b), (0, bitboard_1.sw)(b));
    }

"use strict";
/** Dual-u32 bitboard utilities — {lo,hi} storage (bits 0..31 / 32..63) */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.NOT_GH_FILE = exports.NOT_AB_FILE = exports.NOT_H_FILE = exports.NOT_A_FILE = exports.RANK_MASKS = exports.FILE_MASKS = exports.BIT_TABLE = exports.UNIVERSE = exports.EMPTY = void 0;

exports.bit = bit;
exports.cloneBB = cloneBB;
exports.setBit = setBit;
exports.clearBit = clearBit;
exports.setBitMut = setBitMut;
exports.clearBitMut = clearBitMut;
exports.testBit = testBit;
exports.and = and;
exports.or = or;
exports.xor = xor;
exports.not = not;
exports.isEmpty = isEmpty;
exports.intersects = intersects;
exports.bbEq = bbEq;
exports.popcount = popcount;
exports.trailingZeros = trailingZeros;
exports.lsb = lsb;
exports.popLsb = popLsb;

exports.bitsToArray = bitsToArray;

exports.sw = sw;
exports.emptyBB = emptyBB;
exports.EMPTY = { lo: 0, hi: 0 };
exports.UNIVERSE = { lo: 0xffffffff, hi: 0xffffffff };
/** Precomputed square bits (immutable after init) */
exports.BIT_TABLE = new Array(64);
for (let i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
    exports.BIT_TABLE[i] = i < 32
        ? { lo: (1 << i) >>> 0, hi: 0 }
        : { lo: 0, hi: (1 << (i - 32)) >>> 0 };
}
function bb(lo, hi) {
    return { lo: lo >>> 0, hi: hi >>> 0 };
}
function bit(sq) {
    return exports.BIT_TABLE[sq];
}
function cloneBB(a) {
    return { lo: a.lo, hi: a.hi };
}
function setBit(bb, sq) {
    if (sq < 32)
        return { lo: (bb.lo | (1 << sq)) >>> 0, hi: bb.hi };
    return { lo: bb.lo, hi: (bb.hi | (1 << (sq - 32))) >>> 0 };
}
function clearBit(bb, sq) {
    if (sq < 32)
        return { lo: (bb.lo & ~(1 << sq)) >>> 0, hi: bb.hi };
    return { lo: bb.lo, hi: (bb.hi & ~(1 << (sq - 32))) >>> 0 };
}
/** In-place set (mutates bb). */
function setBitMut(bb, sq) {
    if (sq < 32)
        bb.lo = (bb.lo | (1 << sq)) >>> 0;
    else
        bb.hi = (bb.hi | (1 << (sq - 32))) >>> 0;
}
/** In-place clear (mutates bb). */
function clearBitMut(bb, sq) {
    if (sq < 32)
        bb.lo = (bb.lo & ~(1 << sq)) >>> 0;
    else
        bb.hi = (bb.hi & ~(1 << (sq - 32))) >>> 0;
}
function testBit(bb, sq) {
    if (sq < 32)
        return ((bb.lo >>> sq) & 1) !== 0;
    return ((bb.hi >>> (sq - 32)) & 1) !== 0;
}
function and(a, b) {
    return { lo: (a.lo & b.lo) >>> 0, hi: (a.hi & b.hi) >>> 0 };
}
function or(a, b) {
    return { lo: (a.lo | b.lo) >>> 0, hi: (a.hi | b.hi) >>> 0 };
}
function xor(a, b) {
    return { lo: (a.lo ^ b.lo) >>> 0, hi: (a.hi ^ b.hi) >>> 0 };
}
function not(a) {
    return { lo: (~a.lo) >>> 0, hi: (~a.hi) >>> 0 };
}
function isEmpty(a) {
    return a.lo === 0 && a.hi === 0;
}
/** True if a & b is nonempty. */
function intersects(a, b) {
    return ((a.lo & b.lo) !== 0) || ((a.hi & b.hi) !== 0);
}
function bbEq(a, b) {
    return a.lo === b.lo && a.hi === b.hi;
}
function pop32(v) {
    v = v - ((v >>> 1) & 0x55555555);
    v = (v & 0x33333333) + ((v >>> 2) & 0x33333333);
    return (((v + (v >>> 4)) & 0x0f0f0f0f) * 0x01010101) >>> 24;
}
function ctz32(v) {
    return 31 - Math.clz32(v & -v);
}
function popcount(bb) {
    return pop32(bb.lo) + pop32(bb.hi);
}
function trailingZeros(bb) {
    if (bb.lo)
        return ctz32(bb.lo >>> 0);
    if (bb.hi)
        return 32 + ctz32(bb.hi >>> 0);
    return 64;
}
function lsb(bb) {
    return trailingZeros(bb);
}
function popLsb(bb) {
    if (bb.lo) {
        const bit = bb.lo & -bb.lo;
        return { sq: ctz32(bit), bb: { lo: (bb.lo ^ bit) >>> 0, hi: bb.hi } };
    }
    if (bb.hi) {
        const bit = bb.hi & -bb.hi;
        return { sq: 32 + ctz32(bit), bb: { lo: 0, hi: (bb.hi ^ bit) >>> 0 } };
    }
    return { sq: 64, bb: { lo: 0, hi: 0 } };
}
function forEachBit(bb, fn) {
    let lo = bb.lo >>> 0;
    let hi = bb.hi >>> 0;
    while (lo) {
        const b = lo & -lo;
        fn(31 - Math.clz32(b));
        lo ^= b;
    }
    while (hi) {
        const b = hi & -hi;
        fn(32 + (31 - Math.clz32(b)));
        hi ^= b;
    }
}
function bitsToArray(bb) {
    const arr = [];
    forEachBit(bb, (s) => arr.push(s));
    return arr;
}
/** Convert dual-u32 ↔ bigint (pawn hash / debug). */
function bbToBig(b) {
    return BigInt(b.lo >>> 0) | (BigInt(b.hi >>> 0) << 32n);
}
function bbFromBig(v) {
    return {
        lo: Number(v & 0xffffffffn) >>> 0,
        hi: Number((v >> 32n) & 0xffffffffn) >>> 0,
    };
}
// File/rank masks
exports.FILE_MASKS = [];
exports.RANK_MASKS = [];
for (let f = 0; f < 8; f++) {
    let lo = 0, hi = 0;
    for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
        const s = r * 8 + f;
        if (s < 32)
            lo |= (1 << s) >>> 0;
        else
            hi |= (1 << (s - 32)) >>> 0;
    }
    exports.FILE_MASKS[f] = { lo: lo >>> 0, hi: hi >>> 0 };
}
for (let r = 0; r < 8; r++) {
    let lo = 0, hi = 0;
    for (let f = 0; f < 8; f++) {
        const s = r * 8 + f;
        if (s < 32)
            lo |= (1 << s) >>> 0;
        else
            hi |= (1 << (s - 32)) >>> 0;
    }
    exports.RANK_MASKS[r] = { lo: lo >>> 0, hi: hi >>> 0 };
}
exports.NOT_A_FILE = not(exports.FILE_MASKS[0]);
exports.NOT_H_FILE = not(exports.FILE_MASKS[7]);
exports.NOT_AB_FILE = not(or(exports.FILE_MASKS[0], exports.FILE_MASKS[1]));
exports.NOT_GH_FILE = not(or(exports.FILE_MASKS[6], exports.FILE_MASKS[7]));
function north(a) {
    const lo = (a.lo << 8) >>> 0;
    const spill = a.lo >>> 24;
    const hi = ((a.hi << 8) | spill) >>> 0;
    return { lo, hi };
}
function south(a) {
    const hi = a.hi >>> 8;
    const spill = (a.hi & 0xff) << 24;
    const lo = ((a.lo >>> 8) | spill) >>> 0;
    return { lo, hi };
}
function east(a) {
    // << 1 then clear A-file
    const lo = (a.lo << 1) >>> 0;
    const spill = a.lo >>> 31;
    const hi = ((a.hi << 1) | spill) >>> 0;
    return and({ lo, hi }, exports.NOT_A_FILE);
}
function west(a) {
    const hi = a.hi >>> 1;
    const spill = (a.hi & 1) << 31;
    const lo = ((a.lo >>> 1) | spill) >>> 0;
    return and({ lo, hi }, exports.NOT_H_FILE);
}
function ne(a) { return east(north(a)); }
function nw(a) { return west(north(a)); }
function se(a) { return east(south(a)); }
function sw(a) { return west(south(a)); }
/** Empty BB factory (mutable). */
function emptyBB() {
    return { lo: 0, hi: 0 };
}

## board/board.js

    constructor(move, castling, epSquare, halfmove, zHi, zLo, captured) {
        this.move = move;
        this.castling = castling;
        this.epSquare = epSquare;

/** g1: preallocated undo stack, U_STRIDE Int32 fields per ply (no per-move allocation). */
const U_FROM = 0, U_TO = 1, U_PIECE = 2, U_CAP = 3, U_PROMO = 4, U_FLAGS = 5, U_CASTLING = 6, U_EP = 7, U_HALF = 8, U_ZHI = 9, U_ZLO = 10;
const U_STRIDE = 12;
const U_INIT_PLIES = 512;

exports.START_FEN = 'rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1';

    /** Compat view (allocates; tools/tests only, not for hot paths). */
    get undoStack() {
        const out = [];
        const u = this.undoBuf;
        for (let i = 0; i < this.undoTop; i++) {
            const t = i * U_STRIDE;
            out.push(new Undo({ from: u[t + U_FROM], to: u[t + U_TO], piece: u[t + U_PIECE], captured: u[t + U_CAP], promo: u[t + U_PROMO], flags: u[t + U_FLAGS] }, u[t + U_CASTLING], u[t + U_EP], u[t + U_HALF], u[t + U_ZHI], u[t + U_ZLO], u[t + U_CAP]));
        }
        return out;
    }
    set undoStack(a) {
        this.undoTop = 0;
        for (const x of a) {
            const t = this.undoSlot();
            const u = this.undoBuf;
            u[t + U_FROM] = x.move.from;
            u[t + U_TO] = x.move.to;
            u[t + U_PIECE] = x.move.piece;
            u[t + U_CAP] = x.move.captured;
            u[t + U_PROMO] = x.move.promo;
            u[t + U_FLAGS] = x.move.flags;
            u[t + U_CASTLING] = x.castling;
            u[t + U_EP] = x.epSquare;
            u[t + U_HALF] = x.halfmove;
            u[t + U_ZHI] = x.zHi;
            u[t + U_ZLO] = x.zLo;
        }
    }
    /** Reserve the next undo entry; returns its base offset (grows the buffer when full). */
    undoSlot() {
        const t = this.undoTop * U_STRIDE;
        if (t + U_STRIDE > this.undoBuf.length) {
            const nb = new Int32Array(this.undoBuf.length * 2);
            nb.set(this.undoBuf);
            this.undoBuf = nb;
        }
        this.undoTop++;
        return t;
    }
    /** Repetition scan over the undo stack (same order/semantics as the old search.isRepetition loop). */
    /** magicflat3: true if the top undo entry is a null move (piece None); no allocation. */
    lastMoveIsNull() {
        return this.undoTop > 0 && this.undoBuf[(this.undoTop - 1) * U_STRIDE + U_PIECE] === 0 /* Piece.None */;
    }
    isRepetitionKey(hi, lo) {
        const u = this.undoBuf;
        for (let t = (this.undoTop - 1) * U_STRIDE; t >= 0; t -= U_STRIDE) {
            if (u[t + U_ZLO] === lo && u[t + U_ZHI] === hi)
                return true;
            const pc = u[t + U_PIECE];
            if (u[t + U_CAP] !== 0 /* Piece.None */ || pc === 1 /* Piece.WP */ || pc === 7 /* Piece.BP */)
                break;
        }
        return false;
    }

            this.pieceBB[i].hi = 0;

    putPiece(piece, s) {

        (0, bitboard_1.setBitMut)(this.pieceBB[piece], s);
        const c = (0, types_1.isWhite)(piece) ? 0 /* Color.White */ : 1 /* Color.Black */;

        this.egScore += (0, incremental_1.putEg)(piece, s);
        this.phase += (0, incremental_1.putPhase)(piece);
    }
    removePiece(s) {
        const piece = this.squares[s];
        if (piece === 0 /* Piece.None */)
            return 0 /* Piece.None */;
        this.mgScore -= (0, incremental_1.putMg)(piece, s);
        this.egScore -= (0, incremental_1.putEg)(piece, s);
        this.phase -= (0, incremental_1.putPhase)(piece);
        this.squares[s] = 0 /* Piece.None */;
        (0, bitboard_1.clearBitMut)(this.pieceBB[piece], s);
        const c = (0, types_1.isWhite)(piece) ? 0 /* Color.White */ : 1 /* Color.Black */;

        (0, bitboard_1.clearBitMut)(this.occupied, s);

    }
    movePiece(from, to) {
        const piece = this.squares[from];
        this.removePiece(from);
        // if destination occupied, remove first
        if (this.squares[to] !== 0 /* Piece.None */)
            this.removePiece(to);
        this.putPiece(piece, to);
    }
    setFen(fen) {
        this.clear();
        const parts = fen.trim().split(/\s+/);
        const rows = parts[0].split('/');
        let s = 56; // A8
        for (const row of rows) {
            for (const ch of row) {
                if (ch >= '1' && ch <= '8') {
                    s += parseInt(ch, 10);
                }
                else {
                    const idx = types_1.PIECE_CHARS.indexOf(ch);
                    if (idx > 0)
                        this.putPiece(idx, s);
                    s++;
                }
            }
            s -= 16;
        }
        this.side = parts[1] === 'b' ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */;
        this.castling = 0;
        if (parts[2] && parts[2] !== '-') {
            if (parts[2].includes('K'))
                this.castling |= 1 /* Castling.WK */;
            if (parts[2].includes('Q'))
                this.castling |= 2 /* Castling.WQ */;
            if (parts[2].includes('k'))
                this.castling |= 4 /* Castling.BK */;
            if (parts[2].includes('q'))
                this.castling |= 8 /* Castling.BQ */;
        }
        this.epSquare = parts[3] ? (0, types_1.parseSq)(parts[3]) : types_1.SQ_NONE;
        this.halfmove = parts[4] ? parseInt(parts[4], 10) : 0;
        this.fullmove = parts[5] ? parseInt(parts[5], 10) : 1;
        this.recomputeZobrist();
    }
    getFen() {
        let fen = '';
        for (let r = 7; r >= 0; r--) {
            let empty = 0;
            for (let f = 0; f < 8; f++) {
                const p = this.squares[(0, types_1.sq)(f, r)];
                if (p === 0 /* Piece.None */)
                    empty++;
                else {
                    if (empty) {
                        fen += empty;
                        empty = 0;
                    }
                    fen += types_1.PIECE_CHARS[p];
                }
            }
            if (empty)
                fen += empty;
            if (r > 0)
                fen += '/';
        }
        fen += this.side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? ' w ' : ' b ';
        let cast = '';
        if (this.castling & 1 /* Castling.WK */)
            cast += 'K';
        if (this.castling & 2 /* Castling.WQ */)
            cast += 'Q';
        if (this.castling & 4 /* Castling.BK */)
            cast += 'k';
        if (this.castling & 8 /* Castling.BQ */)
            cast += 'q';
        fen += cast || '-';
        fen += ' ' + (0, types_1.sqName)(this.epSquare);
        fen += ' ' + this.halfmove + ' ' + this.fullmove;
        return fen;
    }
    recomputeZobrist() {
        let h = 0n;
        for (let s = 0; s < 64; s++) {
            const p = this.squares[s];
            if (p !== 0 /* Piece.None */)
                h ^= (0, zobrist_1.hashPiece)(p, s);
        }
        if (this.side === 1 /* Color.Black */)
            h ^= (0, zobrist_1.hashSide)();
        h ^= (0, zobrist_1.hashCastling)(this.castling);
        h ^= (0, zobrist_1.hashEp)(this.epSquare);
        this.zobrist = h;
    }
    kingSquare(color) {
        return color === 0 /* Color.White */ ? this.whiteKingSq : this.blackKingSq;
    }
    /** Is square attacked by the given color? Scalar lo/hi tests, no intersects/or allocs. */
    isAttacked(s, byColor) {
        if (s < 0 || s > 63)
            return false;
        const occ = this.occupied;
        const pbb = this.pieceBB;
        const o = byColor === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 0 : 6;
        // white attackers use BLACK_PAWN_ATTACKS[s] (squares a white pawn attacks s from), and vice versa
        const pa = byColor === 0 /* Color.White */ ? attacks_1.BLACK_PAWN_ATTACKS[s] : attacks_1.WHITE_PAWN_ATTACKS[s];
        let x = pbb[1 + o];
        if ((pa.lo & x.lo) !== 0 || (pa.hi & x.hi) !== 0)
            return true;
        const kn = attacks_1.KNIGHT_ATTACKS[s];
        x = pbb[2 + o];
        if ((kn.lo & x.lo) !== 0 || (kn.hi & x.hi) !== 0)
            return true;
        const kg = attacks_1.KING_ATTACKS[s];
        x = pbb[6 + o];
        if ((kg.lo & x.lo) !== 0 || (kg.hi & x.hi) !== 0)
            return true;
        const q = pbb[5 + o];
        const oLo = occ.lo, oHi = occ.hi;
        const bi = (0, magics_1.bishopIdx)(s, oLo, oHi);
        const b = pbb[3 + o];
        if ((magics_1.BISHOP_LO[bi] & (b.lo | q.lo)) !== 0 || (magics_1.BISHOP_HI[bi] & (b.hi | q.hi)) !== 0)
            return true;
        const ri = (0, magics_1.rookIdx)(s, oLo, oHi);
        const r = pbb[4 + o];
        if ((magics_1.ROOK_LO[ri] & (r.lo | q.lo)) !== 0 || (magics_1.ROOK_HI[ri] & (r.hi | q.hi)) !== 0)
            return true;
        return false;
    }
    inCheck(color) {
        const c = color === undefined ? this.side : color;
        const ks = this.kingSquare(c);
        return this.isAttacked(ks, c === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */);
    }
    makeMove(m) {
        {
            const t = this.undoSlot();
            const u = this.undoBuf;
            u[t + U_FROM] = m.from;
            u[t + U_TO] = m.to;
            u[t + U_PIECE] = m.piece;
            u[t + U_CAP] = m.captured;
            u[t + U_PROMO] = m.promo;
            u[t + U_FLAGS] = m.flags;
            u[t + U_CASTLING] = this.castling;
            u[t + U_EP] = this.epSquare;
            u[t + U_HALF] = this.halfmove;
            u[t + U_ZHI] = this.zHi;
            u[t + U_ZLO] = this.zLo;
        }
        // Clear EP from hash
        {
            const _i = (0, zobrist_1.epIdx)(this.epSquare);
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZE_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZE_LO[_i];
        }
        this.epSquare = types_1.SQ_NONE;
        const us = this.side;
        const them = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */;
        // Update halfmove
        if (m.piece === 1 /* Piece.WP */ || m.piece === 7 /* Piece.BP */ || m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
            this.halfmove = 0;
        }
        else {
            this.halfmove++;
        }
        // Remove captured
        if (m.flags & types_1.MOVE_ENPASSANT) {
            const capSq = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? m.to - 8 : m.to + 8;
            const cap = this.removePiece(capSq);
            {
                const _i = cap * 64 + capSq;
                this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
            }
        }
        else if (m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
            this.removePiece(m.to);
            {
                const _i = m.captured * 64 + m.to;
                this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
            }
        }
        // Move piece
        {
            const _i = m.piece * 64 + m.from;
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
        }
        this.removePiece(m.from);
        let placed = m.piece;
        if (m.promo !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
            placed = m.promo;
        }
        this.putPiece(placed, m.to);
        {
            const _i = placed * 64 + m.to;
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
        }
        // Castling rook move
        if (m.flags & types_1.MOVE_CASTLE) {
            if (m.to === 6) { // white O-O: rook H1->F1
                {
                    const _i = 4 /* Piece.WR */ * 64 + 7;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                {
                    const _i = 4 /* Piece.WR */ * 64 + 5;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                this.movePiece(7, 5);
            }
            else if (m.to === 2) { // white O-O-O
                {
                    const _i = 4 /* Piece.WR */ * 64 + 0;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                {
                    const _i = 4 /* Piece.WR */ * 64 + 3;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                this.movePiece(0, 3);
            }
            else if (m.to === 62) { // black O-O
                {
                    const _i = 10 /* Piece.BR */ * 64 + 63;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                {
                    const _i = 10 /* Piece.BR */ * 64 + 61;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                this.movePiece(63, 61);
            }
            else if (m.to === 58) { // black O-O-O
                {
                    const _i = 10 /* Piece.BR */ * 64 + 56;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                {
                    const _i = 10 /* Piece.BR */ * 64 + 59;
                    this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZP_HI[_i];
                    this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZP_LO[_i];
                }
                this.movePiece(56, 59);
            }
        }
        // Double pawn push -> set EP
        if (m.flags & types_1.MOVE_DOUBLE) {
            this.epSquare = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? m.from + 8 : m.from - 8;
        }
        // Update castling rights
        {
            const _i = this.castling & 15;
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZC_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZC_LO[_i];
        }
        if (m.piece === 6 /* Piece.WK */ || m.from === 4) {
            this.castling &= ~(1 /* Castling.WK */ | 2 /* Castling.WQ */);
        }
        if (m.piece === 12 /* Piece.BK */ || m.from === 60) {
            this.castling &= ~(4 /* Castling.BK */ | 8 /* Castling.BQ */);
        }
        if (m.from === 0 || m.to === 0)
            this.castling &= ~2 /* Castling.WQ */;
        if (m.from === 7 || m.to === 7)
            this.castling &= ~1 /* Castling.WK */;
        if (m.from === 56 || m.to === 56)
            this.castling &= ~8 /* Castling.BQ */;
        if (m.from === 63 || m.to === 63)
            this.castling &= ~4 /* Castling.BK */;
        {
            const _i = this.castling & 15;
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZC_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZC_LO[_i];
        }
        {
            const _i = (0, zobrist_1.epIdx)(this.epSquare);
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZE_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZE_LO[_i];
        }
        this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZS_HI;
        this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZS_LO;
        this.side = them;
        if (us === 1 /* Color.Black */)
            this.fullmove++;
        // legality: own king not in check
        if (this.inCheck(us)) {
            this.unmakeMove();
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    unmakeMove() {
        if (this.undoTop === 0)
            return;
        this.undoTop--;
        const u = this.undoBuf;
        const t = this.undoTop * U_STRIDE;
        const mFrom = u[t + U_FROM], mTo = u[t + U_TO], mPiece = u[t + U_PIECE], mCap = u[t + U_CAP], mFlags = u[t + U_FLAGS];
        const us = this.side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */; // side that moved
        this.side = us;
        if (us === 1 /* Color.Black */)
            this.fullmove--;
        this.castling = u[t + U_CASTLING];
        this.epSquare = u[t + U_EP];
        this.halfmove = u[t + U_HALF];
        this.zHi = u[t + U_ZHI];
        this.zLo = u[t + U_ZLO];
        // Undo castling rook
        if (mFlags & types_1.MOVE_CASTLE) {
            if (mTo === 6)
                this.movePiece(5, 7);
            else if (mTo === 2)
                this.movePiece(3, 0);
            else if (mTo === 62)
                this.movePiece(61, 63);
            else if (mTo === 58)
                this.movePiece(59, 56);
        }
        // Remove piece from to (promo or normal)
        this.removePiece(mTo);
        this.putPiece(mPiece, mFrom);
        // Restore captured
        if (mFlags & types_1.MOVE_ENPASSANT) {
            const capSq = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? mTo - 8 : mTo + 8;
            this.putPiece(mCap, capSq);
        }
        else if (mCap !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
            this.putPiece(mCap, mTo);
        }
    }
    /** Null move for NMP */
    makeNullMove() {
        {
            const t = this.undoSlot();
            const u = this.undoBuf;
            u[t + U_FROM] = 0;
            u[t + U_TO] = 0;
            u[t + U_PIECE] = 0 /* Piece.None */;
            u[t + U_CAP] = 0 /* Piece.None */;
            u[t + U_PROMO] = 0 /* Piece.None */;
            u[t + U_FLAGS] = 0;
            u[t + U_CASTLING] = this.castling;
            u[t + U_EP] = this.epSquare;
            u[t + U_HALF] = this.halfmove;
            u[t + U_ZHI] = this.zHi;
            u[t + U_ZLO] = this.zLo;
        }
        {
            const _i = (0, zobrist_1.epIdx)(this.epSquare);
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZE_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZE_LO[_i];
        }
        this.epSquare = types_1.SQ_NONE;
        {
            const _i = (0, zobrist_1.epIdx)(this.epSquare);
            this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZE_HI[_i];
            this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZE_LO[_i];
        }
        this.zHi ^= zobrist_1.ZS_HI;
        this.zLo ^= zobrist_1.ZS_LO;
        this.side = this.side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */;
        this.halfmove++;
    }
    unmakeNullMove() {
        if (this.undoTop === 0)
            return;
        this.undoTop--;
        const u = this.undoBuf;
        const t = this.undoTop * U_STRIDE;
        this.side = this.side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */;
        this.castling = u[t + U_CASTLING];
        this.epSquare = u[t + U_EP];
        this.halfmove = u[t + U_HALF];
        this.zHi = u[t + U_ZHI];
        this.zLo = u[t + U_ZLO];
    }
    toString() {
        let s = '';
        for (let r = 7; r >= 0; r--) {
            s += (r + 1) + ' ';
            for (let f = 0; f < 8; f++) {
                s += types_1.PIECE_CHARS[this.squares[(0, types_1.sq)(f, r)]] + ' ';
            }
            s += '\n';
        }
        s += '  a b c d e f g h\n';
        s += this.getFen();
        return s;
    }
}
exports.Board = Board;

function initMagics() {
    if (ready)
        return;

        path.join(__dirname, 'magic_data.json'),
        path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', 'src', 'board', 'magic_data.json'),
        path.join(process.cwd(), 'src', 'board', 'magic_data.json'),
        path.join(process.cwd(), 'dist', 'board', 'magic_data.json'),
    ];
    let raw = null;

        }
        catch { /* continue */ }
    }

        throw new Error('magic_data.json not found');
    const data = JSON.parse(raw);

        exports.ROOK_MAGIC[e.sq] = (0, bitboard_1.bbFromBig)(BigInt(e.magic));
        exports.ROOK_SHIFT[e.sq] = 64 - e.bits;
        exports.ROOK_ATTACKS[e.sq] = e.attacks.map((a) => (0, bitboard_1.bbFromBig)(BigInt(a)));
    }

        exports.BISHOP_SHIFT[e.sq] = 64 - e.bits;

    }

        rn += exports.ROOK_ATTACKS[q].length;
        exports.BISHOP_OFF[q] = bn;
        bn += exports.BISHOP_ATTACKS[q].length;
    }
    exports.ROOK_LO = new Uint32Array(rn);
    exports.ROOK_HI = new Uint32Array(rn);
    exports.BISHOP_LO = new Uint32Array(bn);
    exports.BISHOP_HI = new Uint32Array(bn);
    for (let q = 0; q < 64; q++) {
        const ra = exports.ROOK_ATTACKS[q], ba = exports.BISHOP_ATTACKS[q];
        for (let i = 0; i < ra.length; i++) {
            exports.ROOK_LO[exports.ROOK_OFF[q] + i] = ra[i].lo;
            exports.ROOK_HI[exports.ROOK_OFF[q] + i] = ra[i].hi;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < ba.length; i++) {
            exports.BISHOP_LO[exports.BISHOP_OFF[q] + i] = ba[i].lo;
            exports.BISHOP_HI[exports.BISHOP_OFF[q] + i] = ba[i].hi;

        RM_HI[q] = exports.ROOK_MASK[q].hi;

    }

/** Magic index on scalars (same arithmetic as magicIndex). */
function magicIdx(lo, hi, mLo, mHi, shift) {
    const ah = lo >>> 16, al = lo & 0xffff;
    const bh = mLo >>> 16, bl = mLo & 0xffff;
    const p0 = al * bl;
    const p1 = ah * bl;
    const p2 = al * bh;
    const p3 = ah * bh;
    const mid = (p0 >>> 16) + (p1 & 0xffff) + (p2 & 0xffff);
    const pLo = ((p0 & 0xffff) | ((mid & 0xffff) << 16)) >>> 0;
    const lh = (p3 + (p1 >>> 16) + (p2 >>> 16) + (mid >>> 16)) >>> 0;
    const pHi = (lh + ((Math.imul(lo, mHi) + Math.imul(hi, mLo)) >>> 0)) >>> 0;
    if (shift >= 32)
        return pHi >>> (shift - 32);
    if (shift === 0)
        return pLo;
    return ((pLo >>> shift) | (pHi << (32 - shift))) >>> 0;
}
/** Flat index into ROOK_LO/ROOK_HI for sq with occupancy (oLo,oHi). Allocation-free. */
function rookIdx(sq, oLo, oHi) {
    return exports.ROOK_OFF[sq] + magicIdx((oLo & RM_LO[sq]) >>> 0, (oHi & RM_HI[sq]) >>> 0, RG_LO[sq], RG_HI[sq], R_SH[sq]);
}
/** Flat index into BISHOP_LO/BISHOP_HI. Allocation-free. */
function bishopIdx(sq, oLo, oHi) {
    return exports.BISHOP_OFF[sq] + magicIdx((oLo & BM_LO[sq]) >>> 0, (oHi & BM_HI[sq]) >>> 0, BG_LO[sq], BG_HI[sq], B_SH[sq]);
}
/** 32×32 → 64 unsigned multiply. */
function umul32(a, b) {
    a >>>= 0;
    b >>>= 0;
    const ah = a >>> 16, al = a & 0xffff;
    const bh = b >>> 16, bl = b & 0xffff;
    const p0 = al * bl;
    const p1 = ah * bl;
    const p2 = al * bh;
    const p3 = ah * bh;
    const mid = (p0 >>> 16) + (p1 & 0xffff) + (p2 & 0xffff);
    const lo = ((p0 & 0xffff) | ((mid & 0xffff) << 16)) >>> 0;
    const hi = (p3 + (p1 >>> 16) + (p2 >>> 16) + (mid >>> 16)) >>> 0;
    return [lo, hi];
}
/** Low 64 bits of 64×64 unsigned multiply (no BigInt). */
function mul64lo(aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi) {
    const [ll, lh] = umul32(aLo, bLo);
    const cross = (Math.imul(aLo >>> 0, bHi >>> 0) + Math.imul(aHi >>> 0, bLo >>> 0)) >>> 0;
    return [ll, (lh + cross) >>> 0];
}
/** Magic index via dual-u32 multiply + shift (allocation-free: no tuple returns). */
function magicIndex(occ, mask, magic, shift) {
    const lo = (occ.lo & mask.lo) >>> 0;
    const hi = (occ.hi & mask.hi) >>> 0;
    const mLo = magic.lo >>> 0;
    // umul32(lo, mLo) inline
    const ah = lo >>> 16, al = lo & 0xffff;
    const bh = mLo >>> 16, bl = mLo & 0xffff;
    const p0 = al * bl;
    const p1 = ah * bl;
    const p2 = al * bh;
    const p3 = ah * bh;
    const mid = (p0 >>> 16) + (p1 & 0xffff) + (p2 & 0xffff);
    const pLo = ((p0 & 0xffff) | ((mid & 0xffff) << 16)) >>> 0;
    const lh = (p3 + (p1 >>> 16) + (p2 >>> 16) + (mid >>> 16)) >>> 0;
    // cross terms = high word of mul64lo (same as Math.imul(aLo, bHi) + Math.imul(aHi, bLo))
    const pHi = (lh + ((Math.imul(lo, magic.hi >>> 0) + Math.imul(hi, mLo)) >>> 0)) >>> 0;
    if (shift >= 32)
        return pHi >>> (shift - 32);
    if (shift === 0)
        return pLo;
    return ((pLo >>> shift) | (pHi << (32 - shift))) >>> 0;
}
function rookAttacksMagic(sq, occ) {
    const idx = magicIndex(occ, exports.ROOK_MASK[sq], exports.ROOK_MAGIC[sq], exports.ROOK_SHIFT[sq]);
    return exports.ROOK_ATTACKS[sq][idx];
}
function bishopAttacksMagic(sq, occ) {
    const idx = magicIndex(occ, exports.BISHOP_MASK[sq], exports.BISHOP_MAGIC[sq], exports.BISHOP_SHIFT[sq]);
    return exports.BISHOP_ATTACKS[sq][idx];
}
function queenAttacksMagic(sq, occ) {
    return (0, bitboard_1.or)(rookAttacksMagic(sq, occ), bishopAttacksMagic(sq, occ));
}
// Eager init
initMagics();

// Deterministic PRNG (xorshift64*) for reproducible keys
function makeRng(seed) {
    let s = seed;
    return () => {
        s ^= s >> 12n;
        s ^= s << 25n;
        s ^= s >> 27n;
        s = (s * 0x2545f4914f6cdd1dn) & 0xffffffffffffffffn;
        return s;
    };
}

function evalPawns(wPawns, bPawns) {

function hasSq(lo, hi, sq) { return sq < 32 ? ((lo >>> sq) & 1) === 1 : ((hi >>> (sq - 32)) & 1) === 1; }
function pop32(v) { v = v - ((v >>> 1) & 0x55555555); v = (v & 0x33333333) + ((v >>> 2) & 0x33333333); return (((v + (v >>> 4)) & 0x0f0f0f0f) * 0x01010101) >>> 24; }

function evalRest(board, wPawns, bPawns, waL, waH, baL, baH) {
    let mg = 0, eg = 0;
    const occ = board.occupied;
    const wKing = board.whiteKingSq;
    const bKing = board.blackKingSq;
    const wKZl = wKing < 64 ? KZ_LO[wKing] : 0, wKZh = wKing < 64 ? KZ_HI[wKing] : 0;

            eg += imEg;
        }
        if (bMin > wMin && bP >= wP) {

    restEg = eg;

/** dirOff: 0 = white (shelter on ranks above), 64 = black (ranks below) */
function kingShelter(pl, ph, ks, dirOff) {
    if (ks >= 64)
        return 0;
    const k = dirOff + ks;
    let score = (pop32(pl & SH_NEAR_LO[k]) + pop32(ph & SH_NEAR_HI[k])) * weights_1.W.shelterNear
        + (pop32(pl & SH_FAR_LO[k]) + pop32(ph & SH_FAR_HI[k])) * weights_1.W.shelterFar;
    const f = ks & 7;
    const open = weights_1.W.openFileNearKing;
    if (f > 0 && ((pl & FM_LO[f - 1]) | (ph & FM_HI[f - 1])) === 0)
        score -= open;
    if (((pl & FM_LO[f]) | (ph & FM_HI[f])) === 0)
        score -= open;
    if (f < 7 && ((pl & FM_LO[f + 1]) | (ph & FM_HI[f + 1])) === 0)
        score -= open;
    return score;
}
/** Qsearch eval: incremental + pawns + king shelter (no mobility) */
function evaluateQ(board) {
    let mg = board.mgScore;
    let eg = board.egScore;
    let phase = board.phase;
    if (phase > 24)
        phase = 24;
    if (phase < 0)
        phase = 0;
    if ((0, bitboard_1.popcount)(board.pieceBB[3 /* Piece.WB */]) >= 2) {
        mg += weights_1.W.bishopPairMg;
        eg += weights_1.W.bishopPairEg;
    }
    if ((0, bitboard_1.popcount)(board.pieceBB[9 /* Piece.BB */]) >= 2) {
        mg -= weights_1.W.bishopPairMg;
        eg -= weights_1.W.bishopPairEg;
    }
    const qwp = board.pieceBB[1 /* Piece.WP */], qbp = board.pieceBB[7 /* Piece.BP */];
    const qwl = qwp.lo, qwh = qwp.hi, qbl = qbp.lo, qbh = qbp.hi;
    const qpi = (0, pawnhash_1.probePawnIdx)(qwl, qwh, qbl, qbh);
    if (qpi < 0) {
        const pr = evalPawns(qwp, qbp);
        (0, pawnhash_1.storePawnIdx)(qpi, qwl, qwh, qbl, qbh, pr.mg, pr.eg, pr.wpa, pr.bpa);
        mg += pr.mg;
        eg += pr.eg;
    }
    else {
        mg += (0, pawnhash_1.pawnMg)(qpi);
        eg += (0, pawnhash_1.pawnEg)(qpi);
    }
    mg += kingShelter(qwl, qwh, board.whiteKingSq, 0);
    mg -= kingShelter(qbl, qbh, board.blackKingSq, 64);
    let score = ((mg * phase + eg * (24 - phase)) / 24) | 0;
    score += board.side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? weights_1.W.tempo : -weights_1.W.tempo;
    return board.side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? score : -score;
}
exports.evaluateFast = evaluateQ;

/** NNUE 768->Hx2->1 (clipped ReLU, matches /workspace/chess-tools/nnue/train.py export), int16 weights, lazy incremental accumulator stack. UNPROVEN experiment.
 * Net file (little-endian):
 *   magic 'GKNN' (u32 0x4E4E4B47), version u32 = 1, hidden u32 = H (any 8..1024),
 *   ftW int16[768*H] (feature-major: w[f*H+j]), ftB int16[H],
 *   outW int16[2H] (first H = side-to-move half, next H = other half), outB int32 (scaled QA*QB).
 * Feature (white persp.) = (type + 6*color)*64 + sq, type 0..5 = P..K, color 0=W;
 * black persp. = (type + 6*(1-color))*64 + (sq^56).
 * eval_cp = (sum_j clamp(acc,0,QA)*w + outB) * SCALE / (QA*QB), QA=255, QB=64, SCALE=400.
 *
 * The accumulator stack is indexed by board.undoStack.length and tagged with the position key
 * (zHi/zLo). On eval it walks back to the nearest valid ancestor and replays the undo moves, so
 * board/move/tt code is untouched (no hooks in makeMove/unmakeMove).
 */

const path = __importStar(require("path"));
let HID = 128;
function hiddenSize() { return HID; }
const NFEAT = 768;
const QA = 255, QB = 64, SCALE = 400;
const MAGIC = 0x4E4E4B47;
let ftW = new Int16Array(NFEAT * HID);
let ftB = new Int16Array(HID);
let outW = new Int16Array(2 * HID);
let outB = 0;
let loaded = false;
let enabled = true;
let loadedPath = '';
let lastError = '';
// nncache: bumped on net load / UseNNUE toggle so evaluate.js drops cached scores from the other evaluator; UNPROVEN
let evalGen = 1;
function nnueGen() { return evalGen; }
exports.resolvedDefaultPath = '';
// feature index tables: FW[piece*64+sq], FB[piece*64+sq] -> feature offset (already * HID)
const FW = new Int32Array(13 * 64);
const FB = new Int32Array(13 * 64);
function buildTables() {
    for (let p = 1; p <= 12; p++) {
        const type = p <= 6 ? p - 1 : p - 7;
        const color = p <= 6 ? 0 : 1;
        for (let s = 0; s < 64; s++) {
            FW[p * 64 + s] = ((type + 6 * color) * 64 + s) * HID;
            FB[p * 64 + s] = ((type + 6 * (1 - color)) * 64 + (s ^ 56)) * HID;
        }
    }
}
buildTables();
function allocAcc() {
    accW = new Int16Array(CAP * HID);
    accB = new Int16Array(CAP * HID);
    keyHi = new Int32Array(CAP);
    keyLo = new Int32Array(CAP);
    valid = new Uint8Array(CAP);
}
let CAP = 1024;
let accW = new Int16Array(CAP * HID);
let accB = new Int16Array(CAP * HID);
let keyHi = new Int32Array(CAP);
let keyLo = new Int32Array(CAP);
let valid = new Uint8Array(CAP);
function grow(need) {
    let n = CAP;
    while (n <= need)
        n *= 2;
    const nw = new Int16Array(n * HID);
    nw.set(accW);
    accW = nw;
    const nb = new Int16Array(n * HID);
    nb.set(accB);
    accB = nb;
    const kh = new Int32Array(n);
    kh.set(keyHi);
    keyHi = kh;
    const kl = new Int32Array(n);
    kl.set(keyLo);
    keyLo = kl;
    const v = new Uint8Array(n);
    v.set(valid);
    valid = v;
    CAP = n;
}
function resetAccumulators() { valid.fill(0); }
/** Load a net; on any failure the previous net is dropped (HCE fallback) and lastError is set. */
function loadNet(file) {
    // v6: on failure keep the previously loaded net (state is only replaced on success)
    return loadNetInner(file);
}
function loadNetInner(file) {
    try {
        const buf = fs.readFileSync(file);
        const dv = new DataView(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, buf.byteLength);
        lastError = 'bad header/size';
        if (buf.byteLength < 12 || dv.getUint32(0, true) !== MAGIC || dv.getUint32(4, true) !== 1)
            return false;
        const H = dv.getUint32(8, true);
        if (H < 8 || H > 1024 || buf.byteLength !== 12 + (NFEAT * H + H + 2 * H) * 2 + 4)
            return false;
        let o = 12;
        const rd = (a) => { for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++, o += 2)
            a[i] = dv.getInt16(o, true); };
        const w = new Int16Array(NFEAT * H), b = new Int16Array(H), ow = new Int16Array(2 * H);
        rd(w);
        rd(b);
        rd(ow);
        // int16 accumulator safety: |ftB| + 32*max|ftW| < 32767 (at most 32 pieces active)
        let mw = 0, mb = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < w.length; i++) {
            const a = w[i] < 0 ? -w[i] : w[i];
            if (a > mw)
                mw = a;
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) {
            const a = b[i] < 0 ? -b[i] : b[i];
            if (a > mb)
                mb = a;
        }
        if (mb + 32 * mw >= 32767) {
            lastError = `weight bound violated: max|ftB| ${mb} + 32*max|ftW| ${mw} >= 32767`;
            return false;
        }
        ftW = w;
        ftB = b;
        outW = ow;
        outB = dv.getInt32(o, true);
        if (H !== HID) {
            HID = H;
            buildTables();
            allocAcc();
        }
        loaded = true;
        evalGen++;
        loadedPath = file;
        lastError = '';
        resetAccumulators();
        return true;
    }
    catch (e) {
        lastError = String(e.message || e);
        return false;
    }
}
function setUseNNUE(on) { if (enabled !== on) evalGen++; enabled = on; }
function nnueActive() { return enabled && loaded; }
function nnueInfo() { return (lastError ? `last EvalFile load failed (${lastError}); ` : '') + (loaded ? `NNUE ${enabled ? 'on' : 'off'} file ${loadedPath}` : 'NNUE no net loaded (HCE)'); }
/** Full refresh of slot d from the board. */
function refresh(board, d) {
    const ow = d * HID;
    for (let j = 0; j < HID; j++) {
        accW[ow + j] = ftB[j];
        accB[ow + j] = ftB[j];
    }
    const sqs = board.squares;
    for (let s = 0; s < 64; s++) {
        const p = sqs[s];
        if (p === 0)
            continue;
        const fw = FW[p * 64 + s], fb = FB[p * 64 + s];
        for (let j = 0; j < HID; j++) {
            accW[ow + j] += ftW[fw + j];
            accB[ow + j] += ftW[fb + j];
        }
    }
}
// scratch for deltas
const addW = new Int32Array(2), addB = new Int32Array(2), subW = new Int32Array(2), subB = new Int32Array(2);
/** child slot c = parent slot c-1 + delta of move (from undo info). */
function applyMove(c, from, to, piece, captured, promo, flags) {
    const src = (c - 1) * HID, dst = c * HID;
    if (piece === 0) { // null move
        accW.copyWithin(dst, src, src + HID);
        accB.copyWithin(dst, src, src + HID);
        return;
    }
    const white = piece <= 6;
    const placed = promo !== 0 ? promo : piece;
    let na = 1, ns = 1;
    addW[0] = FW[placed * 64 + to];
    addB[0] = FB[placed * 64 + to];
    subW[0] = FW[piece * 64 + from];
    subB[0] = FB[piece * 64 + from];
    if (flags & 2) { // en passant
        const cs = white ? to - 8 : to + 8;
        subW[1] = FW[captured * 64 + cs];
        subB[1] = FB[captured * 64 + cs];
        ns = 2;
    }
    else if (captured !== 0) {
        subW[1] = FW[captured * 64 + to];
        subB[1] = FB[captured * 64 + to];
        ns = 2;
    }
    else if (flags & 1) { // castle: rook
        let rf = 0, rt = 0;
        if (to === 6) {
            rf = 7;
            rt = 5;
        }
        else if (to === 2) {
            rf = 0;
            rt = 3;
        }
        else if (to === 62) {
            rf = 63;
            rt = 61;
        }
        else {
            rf = 56;
            rt = 59;
        }
        const r = white ? 4 : 10;
        addW[1] = FW[r * 64 + rt];
        addB[1] = FB[r * 64 + rt];
        subW[1] = FW[r * 64 + rf];
        subB[1] = FB[r * 64 + rf];
        na = 2;
        ns = 2;
    }
    const W = ftW, aw = accW, ab = accB;
    if (na === 1 && ns === 1) {
        const a0 = addW[0], s0 = subW[0], b0 = addB[0], t0 = subB[0];
        for (let j = 0; j < HID; j++) {
            aw[dst + j] = aw[src + j] + W[a0 + j] - W[s0 + j];
            ab[dst + j] = ab[src + j] + W[b0 + j] - W[t0 + j];
        }
    }
    else if (na === 1) {
        const a0 = addW[0], s0 = subW[0], s1 = subW[1], b0 = addB[0], t0 = subB[0], t1 = subB[1];
        for (let j = 0; j < HID; j++) {
            aw[dst + j] = aw[src + j] + W[a0 + j] - W[s0 + j] - W[s1 + j];
            ab[dst + j] = ab[src + j] + W[b0 + j] - W[t0 + j] - W[t1 + j];
        }
    }
    else {
        const a0 = addW[0], a1 = addW[1], s0 = subW[0], s1 = subW[1];
        const b0 = addB[0], b1 = addB[1], t0 = subB[0], t1 = subB[1];
        for (let j = 0; j < HID; j++) {
            aw[dst + j] = aw[src + j] + W[a0 + j] + W[a1 + j] - W[s0 + j] - W[s1 + j];
            ab[dst + j] = ab[src + j] + W[b0 + j] + W[b1 + j] - W[t0 + j] - W[t1 + j];
        }
    }
}
/** Make slot d (= board.undoStack.length) current, incrementally where possible. Returns d. */
function updateAccumulator(board) {
    const us = board.undoStack;
    const d = us.length;
    if (d >= CAP)
        grow(d);
    if (valid[d] && keyHi[d] === board.zHi && keyLo[d] === board.zLo)
        return d;
    // find nearest valid ancestor k whose key matches the position at depth k
    let k = d - 1;
    const LIMIT = d - 64;
    while (k >= 0 && k > LIMIT) {
        const u = us[k];
        if (valid[k] && keyHi[k] === u.zHi && keyLo[k] === u.zLo)
            break;
        k--;
    }
    if (k < 0 || k <= LIMIT) {
        refresh(board, d);
    }
    else {
        for (let c = k + 1; c <= d; c++) {
            const m = us[c - 1].move;
            applyMove(c, m.from, m.to, m.piece, m.captured, m.promo, m.flags);
            if (c < d) {
                const u = us[c];
                keyHi[c] = u.zHi;
                keyLo[c] = u.zLo;
                valid[c] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    keyHi[d] = board.zHi;
    keyLo[d] = board.zLo;
    valid[d] = 1;
    return d;
}
/** Side-to-move-relative eval in centipawns. */
function nnueEvaluate(board) {
    const d = updateAccumulator(board);
    const o = d * HID;
    const stm = board.side === 0 ? accW : accB;
    const nst = board.side === 0 ? accB : accW;
    const ow = outW, H = HID;
    let sum = 0;
    for (let j = 0; j < H; j++) {
        let v = stm[o + j];
        v = v < 0 ? 0 : v > QA ? QA : v;
        let x = nst[o + j];
        x = x < 0 ? 0 : x > QA ? QA : x;
        sum += v * ow[j] + x * ow[H + j];
    }
    const v = ((sum + outB) * SCALE / (QA * QB)) | 0;
    // v6: clamp below MATE_BOUND / TT int16 range
    return v > 28000 ? 28000 : v < -28000 ? -28000 : v;
}
/** Testing: full-refresh eval vs incremental slot, returns true if accumulators match. */
function checkAccumulator(board) {
    const d = updateAccumulator(board);
    const tmp = CAP - 1; // use last slot as scratch
    if (d >= tmp)
        return true;
    refresh(board, tmp);
    const a = d * HID, b = tmp * HID;
    for (let j = 0; j < HID; j++)
        if (accW[a + j] !== accW[b + j] || accB[a + j] !== accB[b + j]) {
            valid[tmp] = 0;
            return false;
        }
    valid[tmp] = 0;
    return true;
}
// Default net: $GROKCHESS_NNUE, else <dist>/net.nnue. Missing file -> HCE fallback.
{
    const def = path.resolve(process.env.GROKCHESS_NNUE || path.join(__dirname, '..', 'net.nnue'));
    exports.resolvedDefaultPath = def;
    if (process.env.GROKCHESS_USE_NNUE === '0')
        enabled = false;
    if (fs.existsSync(def))
        loadNet(def);
}
//# sourceMappingURL=nnue.js.map```

"use strict";
/** Pawn structure hash cache (exact-compare, u32 keys, no BigInt, no allocation on probe).
 *  Also caches the pawn attack sets used by eval5 safe-square mobility. */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.aBH = exports.aBL = exports.aWH = exports.aWL = void 0;
exports.probePawnIdx = probePawnIdx;
exports.storePawnIdx = storePawnIdx;
exports.pawnMg = pawnMg;
exports.pawnEg = pawnEg;
exports.clearPawnCache = clearPawnCache;
const SIZE = 1 << 16;
const MASK = SIZE - 1;
const wLo = new Int32Array(SIZE), wHi = new Int32Array(SIZE), bLo = new Int32Array(SIZE), bHi = new Int32Array(SIZE);
const used = new Uint8Array(SIZE);
const mgArr = new Int32Array(SIZE);
const egArr = new Int32Array(SIZE);
/** pawn attack sets (white / black), lo/hi words */
exports.aWL = new Int32Array(SIZE), exports.aWH = new Int32Array(SIZE), exports.aBL = new Int32Array(SIZE), exports.aBH = new Int32Array(SIZE);
function slot(wl, wh, bl, bh) {
    let h = Math.imul(wl ^ Math.imul(wh, 0x85ebca6b), 0x9e3779b1);
    h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 15) ^ bl, 0xc2b2ae35);
    h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13) ^ Math.imul(bh, 0x27d4eb2f), 0x165667b1);
    return (h ^ (h >>> 16)) & MASK;
}
/** returns slot index if cached else -(slot+1) */
function probePawnIdx(wl, wh, bl, bh) {
    const i = slot(wl, wh, bl, bh);
    if (used[i] === 1 && wLo[i] === (wl | 0) && wHi[i] === (wh | 0) && bLo[i] === (bl | 0) && bHi[i] === (bh | 0))
        return i;
    return -i - 1;
}
function storePawnIdx(neg, wl, wh, bl, bh, mg, eg, wpa, bpa) {
    const i = -neg - 1;
    used[i] = 1;
    wLo[i] = wl;
    wHi[i] = wh;
    bLo[i] = bl;
    bHi[i] = bh;
    mgArr[i] = mg;
    egArr[i] = eg;
    exports.aWL[i] = wpa.lo;
    exports.aWH[i] = wpa.hi;
    exports.aBL[i] = bpa.lo;
    exports.aBH[i] = bpa.hi;
}
function pawnMg(i) { return mgArr[i]; }
function pawnEg(i) { return egArr[i]; }
function clearPawnCache() { used.fill(0); }
//# sourceMappingURL=pawnhash.js.map```

function addMove(moves, from, to, piece, captured, promo, flags) {
    moves.push({ from, to, piece, captured, promo, flags });
}
function addPromotions(moves, from, to, piece, captured, color) {
    const q = (0, types_1.makePiece)(color, 5);
    const r = (0, types_1.makePiece)(color, 4);
    const b = (0, types_1.makePiece)(color, 3);
    const n = (0, types_1.makePiece)(color, 2);
    addMove(moves, from, to, piece, captured, q, 0);
    addMove(moves, from, to, piece, captured, r, 0);
    addMove(moves, from, to, piece, captured, b, 0);
    addMove(moves, from, to, piece, captured, n, 0);

/** Generate all pseudo-legal moves (may leave king in check). Scalar lo/hi + ctz loops, same move order as before. */
function generateMoves(board, capturesOnly = false) {
    const moves = [];
    const us = board.side;
    const them = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */;
    const enemyKing = them === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 6 /* Piece.WK */ : 12 /* Piece.BK */;
    const sq = board.squares;
    const our = board.colorBB[us], their = board.colorBB[them], ek = board.pieceBB[enemyKing];
    const occ = board.occupied;
    const occLo = occ.lo, occHi = occ.hi;
    const nekLo = ~ek.lo, nekHi = ~ek.hi;
    // Never generate king captures
    const theirLo = (their.lo & nekLo) >>> 0, theirHi = (their.hi & nekHi) >>> 0;
    const notOursLo = (~our.lo & nekLo) >>> 0, notOursHi = (~our.hi & nekHi) >>> 0;
    const epSq = board.epSquare;
    // Pawns
    {
        const white = us === 0 /* Color.White */;
        const P = white ? 1 /* Piece.WP */ : 7 /* Piece.BP */;
        const pb = board.pieceBB[P];
        const PA = white ? attacks_1.WHITE_PAWN_ATTACKS : attacks_1.BLACK_PAWN_ATTACKS;
        for (let half = 0; half < 2; half++) {
            let w = half === 0 ? pb.lo : pb.hi;
            while (w) {
                const lsb = w & -w;
                w ^= lsb;
                const from = (half === 0 ? 0 : 32) + 31 - Math.clz32(lsb);
                const push = white ? from + 8 : from - 8;
                if (push >= 0 && push < 64 && !(((push < 32 ? occLo >>> push : occHi >>> (push - 32)) & 1) !== 0)) {
                    if (white ? push >= 56 : push <= 7) {
                        if (!capturesOnly)
                            addPromotions(moves, from, push, P, 0 /* Piece.None */, us);
                    }
                    else if (!capturesOnly) {
                        addMove(moves, from, push, P, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0);
                        if (white ? (from >= 8 && from <= 15) : (from >= 48 && from <= 55)) {
                            const dbl = white ? from + 16 : from - 16;
                            if (!((dbl < 32 ? occLo >>> dbl : occHi >>> (dbl - 32)) & 1)) {
                                addMove(moves, from, dbl, P, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0 /* Piece.None */, types_1.MOVE_DOUBLE);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                const pa = PA[from];
                // Captures
                let cl = (pa.lo & theirLo) >>> 0, ch = (pa.hi & theirHi) >>> 0;
                while (cl) {
                    const b = cl & -cl;
                    cl ^= b;
                    const to = 31 - Math.clz32(b);
                    const cap = sq[to];
                    if (white ? to >= 56 : to <= 7)
                        addPromotions(moves, from, to, P, cap, us);
                    else
                        addMove(moves, from, to, P, cap, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0);
                }
                while (ch) {
                    const b = ch & -ch;
                    ch ^= b;
                    const to = 63 - Math.clz32(b);
                    const cap = sq[to];
                    if (white ? to >= 56 : to <= 7)
                        addPromotions(moves, from, to, P, cap, us);
                    else
                        addMove(moves, from, to, P, cap, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0);
                }
                // En passant
                if (epSq !== types_1.SQ_NONE && (epSq < 32 ? ((pa.lo >>> epSq) & 1) : ((pa.hi >>> (epSq - 32)) & 1)) !== 0) {
                    addMove(moves, from, epSq, P, white ? 7 /* Piece.BP */ : 1 /* Piece.WP */, 0 /* Piece.None */, types_1.MOVE_ENPASSANT);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    const nOff = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 0 : 6;
    // Knights, bishops, rooks, queens
    emitTargets(moves, sq, board.pieceBB[2 + nOff], 0, attacks_1.KNIGHT_ATTACKS, 2 + nOff, capturesOnly, theirLo, theirHi, notOursLo, notOursHi, occ);
    emitTargets(moves, sq, board.pieceBB[3 + nOff], 1, null, 3 + nOff, capturesOnly, theirLo, theirHi, notOursLo, notOursHi, occ);
    emitTargets(moves, sq, board.pieceBB[4 + nOff], 2, null, 4 + nOff, capturesOnly, theirLo, theirHi, notOursLo, notOursHi, occ);
    emitTargets(moves, sq, board.pieceBB[5 + nOff], 3, null, 5 + nOff, capturesOnly, theirLo, theirHi, notOursLo, notOursHi, occ);
    // King
    const king = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 6 /* Piece.WK */ : 12 /* Piece.BK */;
    const kb = board.pieceBB[king];
    emitTargets(moves, sq, kb, 4, attacks_1.KING_ATTACKS, king, capturesOnly, theirLo, theirHi, notOursLo, notOursHi, occ);
    if (!capturesOnly && (kb.lo | kb.hi)) {
        // Castling (same conditions as before; king bitboard non-empty)
        if (us === 0 /* Color.White */) {
            if ((board.castling & 1 /* Castling.WK */) &&
                sq[5] === 0 /* Piece.None */ && sq[6] === 0 /* Piece.None */ &&
                !board.isAttacked(4, 1 /* Color.Black */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(5, 1 /* Color.Black */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(6, 1 /* Color.Black */)) {
                addMove(moves, 4, 6, 6 /* Piece.WK */, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0 /* Piece.None */, types_1.MOVE_CASTLE);
            }
            if ((board.castling & 2 /* Castling.WQ */) &&
                sq[3] === 0 /* Piece.None */ && sq[2] === 0 /* Piece.None */ && sq[1] === 0 /* Piece.None */ &&
                !board.isAttacked(4, 1 /* Color.Black */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(3, 1 /* Color.Black */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(2, 1 /* Color.Black */)) {
                addMove(moves, 4, 2, 6 /* Piece.WK */, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0 /* Piece.None */, types_1.MOVE_CASTLE);
            }
        }
        else {
            if ((board.castling & 4 /* Castling.BK */) &&
                sq[61] === 0 /* Piece.None */ && sq[62] === 0 /* Piece.None */ &&
                !board.isAttacked(60, 0 /* Color.White */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(61, 0 /* Color.White */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(62, 0 /* Color.White */)) {
                addMove(moves, 60, 62, 12 /* Piece.BK */, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0 /* Piece.None */, types_1.MOVE_CASTLE);
            }
            if ((board.castling & 8 /* Castling.BQ */) &&
                sq[59] === 0 /* Piece.None */ && sq[58] === 0 /* Piece.None */ && sq[57] === 0 /* Piece.None */ &&
                !board.isAttacked(60, 0 /* Color.White */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(59, 0 /* Color.White */) &&
                !board.isAttacked(58, 0 /* Color.White */)) {
                addMove(moves, 60, 58, 12 /* Piece.BK */, 0 /* Piece.None */, 0 /* Piece.None */, types_1.MOVE_CASTLE);
            }
        }
    }
    return moves;
}
/** kind: 0 knight table, 1 bishop, 2 rook, 3 queen, 4 king table. */
function emitTargets(moves, sq, pieces, kind, table, piece, capturesOnly, theirLo, theirHi, notOursLo, notOursHi, occ) {
    // orderfast: target mask chosen once per call; leaper table checked by null (kind 0/4 always pass a table).
    const maskLo = capturesOnly ? theirLo : notOursLo, maskHi = capturesOnly ? theirHi : notOursHi;
    if ((pieces.lo | pieces.hi) === 0)
        return;
    for (let half = 0; half < 2; half++) {
        let w = half === 0 ? pieces.lo : pieces.hi;
        while (w) {
            const lsb = w & -w;
            w ^= lsb;
            const from = (half === 0 ? 0 : 32) + 31 - Math.clz32(lsb);
            let tl, th;
            if (table !== null) {
                const a = table[from];
                tl = a.lo;
                th = a.hi;
            }
            else if (kind === 1) {
                const i = (0, magics_1.bishopIdx)(from, occ.lo, occ.hi);
                tl = magics_1.BISHOP_LO[i];
                th = magics_1.BISHOP_HI[i];
            }
            else if (kind === 2) {
                const i = (0, magics_1.rookIdx)(from, occ.lo, occ.hi);
                tl = magics_1.ROOK_LO[i];
                th = magics_1.ROOK_HI[i];
            }
            else {
                const i = (0, magics_1.rookIdx)(from, occ.lo, occ.hi), j = (0, magics_1.bishopIdx)(from, occ.lo, occ.hi);
                tl = magics_1.ROOK_LO[i] | magics_1.BISHOP_LO[j];
                th = magics_1.ROOK_HI[i] | magics_1.BISHOP_HI[j];
            }
            tl = (tl & maskLo) >>> 0;
            th = (th & maskHi) >>> 0;
            while (tl) {
                const b = tl & -tl;
                tl ^= b;
                const to = 31 - Math.clz32(b);
                moves.push({ from, to, piece, captured: sq[to], promo: 0 /* Piece.None */, flags: 0 });
            }
            while (th) {
                const b = th & -th;
                th ^= b;
                const to = 63 - Math.clz32(b);
                moves.push({ from, to, piece, captured: sq[to], promo: 0 /* Piece.None */, flags: 0 });
            }
        }
    }
}
/** Generate strictly legal moves */
function generateLegalMoves(board, capturesOnly = false) {
    const pseudo = generateMoves(board, capturesOnly);
    const legal = [];
    for (const m of pseudo) {
        if (board.makeMove(m)) {
            legal.push(m);
            board.unmakeMove();
        }
    }
    return legal;
}
function moveToUci(m) {
    const files = 'abcdefgh';
    let s = files[m.from & 7] + (1 + (m.from >> 3)) + files[m.to & 7] + (1 + (m.to >> 3));
    if (m.promo !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
        const pt = (0, types_1.pieceType)(m.promo);
        s += '  nbrq'[pt]; // 1=P skip, 2=n, 3=b, 4=r, 5=q
    }
    return s;
}
function parseUciMove(board, uci) {
    if (uci.length < 4)
        return null;
    const from = (uci.charCodeAt(0) - 97) + (uci.charCodeAt(1) - 49) * 8;
    const to = (uci.charCodeAt(2) - 97) + (uci.charCodeAt(3) - 49) * 8;
    let promo = 0 /* Piece.None */;
    if (uci.length >= 5) {
        const ch = uci[4].toLowerCase();
        const us = board.side;
        if (ch === 'q')
            promo = (0, types_1.makePiece)(us, 5);
        else if (ch === 'r')
            promo = (0, types_1.makePiece)(us, 4);
        else if (ch === 'b')
            promo = (0, types_1.makePiece)(us, 3);
        else if (ch === 'n')
            promo = (0, types_1.makePiece)(us, 2);
    }
    const legal = generateLegalMoves(board);
    for (const m of legal) {
        if (m.from === from && m.to === to && m.promo === promo)
            return m;
    }
    // Also match if promo not specified but only one promo exists
    if (promo === 0 /* Piece.None */) {
        for (const m of legal) {
            if (m.from === from && m.to === to)
                return m;
        }
    }
    return null;
}
/** Perft */
function perft(board, depth) {
    if (depth === 0)
        return 1;
    const moves = generateMoves(board);
    let nodes = 0;
    for (const m of moves) {
        if (board.makeMove(m)) {
            if (depth === 1)
                nodes++;
            else
                nodes += perft(board, depth - 1);
            board.unmakeMove();
        }
    }
    return nodes;
}
function perftDivide(board, depth) {
    const result = new Map();
    const moves = generateMoves(board);
    for (const m of moves) {
        if (board.makeMove(m)) {
            const n = depth === 1 ? 1 : perft(board, depth - 1);
            result.set(moveToUci(m), n);
            board.unmakeMove();
        }
    }
    return result;
}

"use strict";
/** Packed integer moves — avoid object allocation in search hot path
 * Layout (32-bit):
 *  0..5   from
 *  6..11  to
 *  12..15 piece
 *  16..19 captured
 *  20..23 promo
 *  24..27 flags
 */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.makeMoveInt = makeMoveInt;
exports.fromOf = fromOf;
exports.toOf = toOf;
exports.pieceOf = pieceOf;
exports.capturedOf = capturedOf;
exports.promoOf = promoOf;
exports.flagsOf = flagsOf;
exports.moveIntToUci = moveIntToUci;
exports.sameMoveInt = sameMoveInt;
exports.fromLegacy = fromLegacy;
function makeMoveInt(from, to, piece, captured, promo, flags) {
    return from | (to << 6) | (piece << 12) | (captured << 16) | (promo << 20) | (flags << 24);
}
function fromOf(m) { return m & 63; }
function toOf(m) { return (m >> 6) & 63; }
function pieceOf(m) { return (m >> 12) & 15; }
function capturedOf(m) { return (m >> 16) & 15; }
function promoOf(m) { return (m >> 20) & 15; }
function flagsOf(m) { return (m >> 24) & 15; }
function moveIntToUci(m) {
    const files = 'abcdefgh';
    const from = fromOf(m), to = toOf(m);
    let s = files[from & 7] + (1 + (from >> 3)) + files[to & 7] + (1 + (to >> 3));
    const promo = promoOf(m);
    if (promo) {
        const pt = promo <= 6 ? promo : promo - 6;
        s += '  nbrq'[pt] || '';
    }
    return s;
}
function sameMoveInt(a, b) {
    return (a & 0x0fff0fff) === (b & 0x0fff0fff); // from, to, promo
}
/** Convert legacy Move object fields */
function fromLegacy(from, to, piece, captured, promo, flags) {
    return makeMoveInt(from, to, piece, captured, promo, flags);
}

## search/givescheck.js

"use strict";
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.givesCheckQuiet = givesCheckQuiet;
const attacks_1 = require("./../board/attacks");
// ALIGN[a*64+b]: 0 none, 1 orthogonal, 2 diagonal. BTW_*: strictly-between squares. LINE_*: full line through a,b.
const ALIGN = new Uint8Array(4096);
const BTW_LO = new Uint32Array(4096), BTW_HI = new Uint32Array(4096);
const LINE_LO = new Uint32Array(4096), LINE_HI = new Uint32Array(4096);
(function init() {
    for (let a = 0; a < 64; a++)
        for (let b = 0; b < 64; b++) {
            if (a === b)
                continue;
            const df = (b & 7) - (a & 7), dr = (b >> 3) - (a >> 3);
            let t = 0;
            if (df === 0 || dr === 0)
                t = 1;
            else if (Math.abs(df) === Math.abs(dr))
                t = 2;
            if (!t)
                continue;
            const i = a * 64 + b;
            ALIGN[i] = t;
            const sf = Math.sign(df), sr = Math.sign(dr);
            for (let f = (a & 7) + sf, r = (a >> 3) + sr; f !== (b & 7) || r !== (b >> 3); f += sf, r += sr) {
                const s = r * 8 + f;
                if (s < 32)
                    BTW_LO[i] |= (1 << s) >>> 0;
                else
                    BTW_HI[i] |= (1 << (s - 32)) >>> 0;
            }
            for (let k = -7; k <= 7; k++) {
                const f = (a & 7) + sf * k, r = (a >> 3) + sr * k;
                if (f < 0 || f > 7 || r < 0 || r > 7)
                    continue;
                const s = r * 8 + f;
                if (s < 32)
                    LINE_LO[i] |= (1 << s) >>> 0;
                else
                    LINE_HI[i] |= (1 << (s - 32)) >>> 0;
            }
        }
})();
function hasBit(lo, hi, s) {
    return s < 32 ? ((lo >>> s) & 1) !== 0 : ((hi >>> (s - 32)) & 1) !== 0;
}
/** Exact "does m give check" for a legal quiet non-castle non-promo move. Callers must not pass castles/promos/ep. */
function givesCheckQuiet(b, m) {
    const from = m.from, to = m.to;
    const white = b.side === 0 /* Color.White */;
    const ks = white ? b.blackKingSq : b.whiteKingSq;
    const occ = b.occupied;
    // occ' = occ - from + to (to is empty: quiet)
    const fLo = from < 32 ? (1 << from) >>> 0 : 0, fHi = from < 32 ? 0 : (1 << (from - 32)) >>> 0;
    // 1) direct check by the moved piece from `to`
    const p = m.piece;
    const pt = white ? p : p - 6;
    if (pt === 2) {
        const a = attacks_1.KNIGHT_ATTACKS[to];
        if (hasBit(a.lo, a.hi, ks))
            return true;
    }
    else if (pt === 1) {
        const a = white ? attacks_1.WHITE_PAWN_ATTACKS[to] : attacks_1.BLACK_PAWN_ATTACKS[to];
        if (hasBit(a.lo, a.hi, ks))
            return true;
    }
    else if (pt >= 3 && pt <= 5) {
        const al = ALIGN[to * 64 + ks];
        if (al !== 0 && (pt === 5 || (pt === 3 ? al === 2 : al === 1))) {
            const i = to * 64 + ks;
            // between squares empty in occ' (from vacated; to is an endpoint)
            if (((BTW_LO[i] & occ.lo & ~fLo) | (BTW_HI[i] & occ.hi & ~fHi)) === 0)
                return true;
        }
    }
    // 2) discovered check: from must be aligned with ks, first blocker from ks, and to off that line
    const fi = from * 64 + ks;
    const al = ALIGN[fi];
    if (al === 0)
        return false;
    if (hasBit(LINE_LO[fi], LINE_HI[fi], to))
        return false;
    if (((BTW_LO[fi] & occ.lo) | (BTW_HI[fi] & occ.hi)) !== 0)
        return false;
    const pb = b.pieceBB;
    const q = white ? pb[5 /* Piece.WQ */] : pb[11 /* Piece.BQ */];
    const s = al === 1 ? (white ? pb[4 /* Piece.WR */] : pb[10 /* Piece.BR */]) : (white ? pb[3 /* Piece.WB */] : pb[9 /* Piece.BB */]);
    // our sliders of the right type on the line beyond from (cheap prefilter)
    const cLo = (q.lo | s.lo) & LINE_LO[fi], cHi = (q.hi | s.hi) & LINE_HI[fi];
    if ((cLo | cHi) === 0)
        return false;
    const tLo = to < 32 ? (1 << to) >>> 0 : 0, tHi = to < 32 ? 0 : (1 << (to - 32)) >>> 0;
    const o = { lo: ((occ.lo & ~fLo) | tLo) >>> 0, hi: ((occ.hi & ~fHi) | tHi) >>> 0 };
    const att = al === 1 ? (0, attacks_1.rookAttacks)(ks, o) : (0, attacks_1.bishopAttacks)(ks, o);
    return ((att.lo & cLo) | (att.hi & cHi)) !== 0;
}

/** Alpha-beta search: PVS, QSearch, NMP, LMR, SEE, futility, razoring, killers, history, aspiration */

/** Cooler main-history gravity (STC ACCEPTED strength @100ms 58% vs v1.6). Drop ad-hoc >>=1. */
