function histUpdate(table, idx, bonus) {
    const b = Math.max(-MAX_HIST, Math.min(MAX_HIST, bonus));
    const v = table[idx] | 0;
    table[idx] = v + b - (((v * Math.abs(b)) / MAX_HIST) | 0);
}
function mainHistBonus(d) {
    // Cooler short-TC: keep bonus modest; malus clearly < bonus.
    return Math.min(180 * d - 90, 1600);
}
function mainHistMalus(d) {
    // ~55% of bonus scale — avoid over-malus under 100ms.
    return Math.min(100 * d - 50, 900);
}
/** Continuation history (1-ply CMH). Index: ((prevPc*64+prevTo)*13+pc)*64+to */
const CMH_SIZE = 13 * 64 * 13 * 64;
const CMH_MAX = 16384;
function cmhIndex(prevPc, prevTo, pc, to) {
    return ((prevPc * 64 + prevTo) * 13 + pc) * 64 + to;
}
function histGravity(table, idx, bonus) {
    const b = Math.max(-CMH_MAX, Math.min(CMH_MAX, bonus | 0));
    const v = table[idx] | 0;
    table[idx] = (v + b - (((v * Math.abs(b)) / CMH_MAX) | 0)) | 0;
}
/** Quadratic CMH gravity (strength ACCEPTED ordering-only @61% vs 1.7.2-nocmh). */
function cmhBonus(d) {
    return Math.min(160 * d * d + 80 * d, 2400);
}
function cmhMalus(d) {
    return Math.min(120 * d * d + 40 * d, 1800);
}
/** Follow-up history (2-ply FUH). Same index shape as CMH; own gravity (not CMH_MAX / main hist). */
const FUH_SIZE = CMH_SIZE;
/** Softer than CMH — first cut FUH_MAX=16384 quad failed 35% vs 1.7.3 */
const FUH_MAX = 8192;
function fuhIndex(prev2Pc, prev2To, pc, to) {
    return cmhIndex(prev2Pc, prev2To, pc, to);
}
function fuhGravity(table, idx, bonus) {
    const b = Math.max(-FUH_MAX, Math.min(FUH_MAX, bonus | 0));
    const v = table[idx] | 0;
    table[idx] = (v + b - (((v * Math.abs(b)) / FUH_MAX) | 0)) | 0;
}
function fuhBonus(d) {
    return Math.min(80 * d * d + 40 * d, 1200);
}
function fuhMalus(d) {
    return Math.min(60 * d * d + 20 * d, 900);
}
/** Capture history for ProbCut ordering only (§8). Not used in quiet ordering or LMR. */
const CAP_SIZE = 13 * 13 * 64;
const CAP_MAX = 8192;
function capIndex(pc, captured, to) {
    return (pc * 13 + captured) * 64 + to;
}
function capGravity(table, idx, bonus) {
    const b = Math.max(-CAP_MAX, Math.min(CAP_MAX, bonus | 0));
    const v = table[idx] | 0;
    table[idx] = (v + b - (((v * Math.abs(b)) / CAP_MAX) | 0)) | 0;
}
/** Smaller than CMH/FUH — ProbCut capture bonus. */
function capBonus(d) {
    return Math.min(40 * d * d + 20 * d, 600);
}
/** Encode a root move for Search.rootMoveNodes lookups. */
function rootMoveKey(m) {
    return m.from | (m.to << 6) | ((m.promo ?? 0) << 12);
}
class Search {
    constructor(board) {
        this.tt = new tt_1.TranspositionTable();
        this.nodes = 0;
        /** Nodes spent under each root move in the current search (all iterations summed).
         *  Key = rootMoveKey(m) = from | to<<6 | promo<<12. Reset at the start of search(). Read-only for callers (timeman). */
        this.rootMoveNodes = new Map();
        this.stop = false;
        this.startTime = 0;
        this.timeLimit = Infinity;
        this.killers = Array.from({ length: MAX_PLY }, () => [null, null]);
        this.history = Array.from({ length: 13 }, () => new Array(64).fill(0));
        this.countermove = new Array(4096).fill(null);
        this.followMove = new Array(4096).fill(null);
        this.contHistory = new Int16Array(CMH_SIZE);
        this.followUpHistory = new Int16Array(FUH_SIZE);
        /** [piece][captured][to] — ProbCut capture ordering only */
        this.capHistory = new Int16Array(CAP_SIZE);
        /** Set during the shallow ProbCut verification search so it cannot nest. */
        this.inProbCut = false;
        this.prevMove = null;
        /** Move from 2 plies ago (same-side previous); keys FUH */
        this.prev2Move = null;
        this.pvTable = Array.from({ length: MAX_PLY }, () => new Array(MAX_PLY));
        this.pvLength = new Array(MAX_PLY).fill(0);
        this.staticAtPly = new Array(MAX_PLY).fill(0);
        this.staticKnown = new Array(MAX_PLY).fill(false);
        this.followPV = false;
        // Reusable move buffers per ply
        this.moveStack = Array.from({ length: MAX_PLY }, () => []);
        this.scoreStack = Array.from({ length: MAX_PLY }, () => []);
        /** SharedArrayBuffer-backed stop flag (Atomics); Lazy SMP cooperative abort */
        this.stopFlag = null;
        /** 0 = main thread; helpers diversify search */
        this.threadId = 0;
        /** Skip root IID (helpers explore different trees) */
        this.skipRootIid = false;
        /** rephist: game position keys before the root (back to last irreversible move), set per job by the worker */
        this.rootHistHi = null;
        this.rootHistLo = null;
        /** Aspiration half-width; helpers use different values */
        this.aspirationWindow = 50;
        /** Seed for history-table noise (0 = none) */
        this.historyNoiseSeed = 0;
        /** At root, rotate ordered quiet moves by this count (helpers) */
        this.rootQuietRotate = 0;
        /** Helpers: on shallow root depths, push TT/PV move later to explore alts */
        this.rootDeferPv = false;
        this.board = board;
    }
    resetHeuristics() {
        for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PLY; i++) {
            this.killers[i][0] = null;
            this.killers[i][1] = null;
        }
        for (let p = 0; p < 13; p++)
            this.history[p].fill(0);
        this.countermove.fill(null);
        this.followMove.fill(null);
        this.contHistory.fill(0);
        this.followUpHistory.fill(0);
        this.capHistory.fill(0);
        this.inProbCut = false;
        this.prevMove = null;
        this.prev2Move = null;
    }
    shouldStop() {
        if (this.stop)
            return true;
        if (this.stopFlag && Atomics.load(this.stopFlag, 0) !== 0) {
            this.stop = true;
            return true;
        }
        if ((this.nodes & 4095) === 0) {
            if (this.stopFlag && Atomics.load(this.stopFlag, 0) !== 0) {
                this.stop = true;
                return true;
            }
            if (Date.now() - this.startTime >= this.timeLimit) {
                this.stop = true;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    /** Root IID: skip if already spent much of a short movetime (IID ate SF samples). */
    allowIidRoot() {
        if (this.skipRootIid)
            return false;
        if (!Number.isFinite(this.timeLimit))
            return true;
        const elapsed = Date.now() - this.startTime;
        if (this.timeLimit < 90)
            return false;
        if (elapsed > this.timeLimit * 0.22)
            return false;
        return true;
    }
    /** Tree/PV IID only when clock has room. */
    allowIidTree() {
        if (!Number.isFinite(this.timeLimit))
            return true;
        const elapsed = Date.now() - this.startTime;
        const remain = this.timeLimit - elapsed;
        if (remain < 45)
            return false;
        if (elapsed > this.timeLimit * 0.55)
            return false;
        return true;
    }
    computeTimeLimit(limits) {
        if (limits.moveTime !== undefined)
            return Math.max(8, limits.moveTime - 8);
        if (limits.infinite)
            return Infinity;
        // Fixed depth without clock: no time cutoff
        if (limits.maxDepth !== undefined && limits.wtime === undefined && limits.btime === undefined && limits.moveTime === undefined) {
            return Infinity;
        }
        const us = this.board.side;
        const time = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? (limits.wtime ?? 0) : (limits.btime ?? 0);
        const inc = us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? (limits.winc ?? 0) : (limits.binc ?? 0);
        if (time > 0) {
            return Math.max(20, Math.min(time / 25 + inc * 0.7, time * 0.4) - 20);
        }
        return 5000;
    }
    search(limits) {
        this.nodes = 0;
        this.rootMoveNodes.clear();
        this.stop = false;
        // ttkeep: count from the UCI `go` timestamp when provided (same clock as main-thread timers)
        this.startTime = limits.startTime ?? Date.now();
        this.timeLimit = this.computeTimeLimit(limits);
        this.tt.prefetchAge();
        this.resetHeuristics();
        if (this.historyNoiseSeed)
            this.seedHistoryNoise(this.historyNoiseSeed);
        const maxDepth = limits.maxDepth ?? 64;
        let bestMove = null;
        let bestScore = 0;
        const ASP = this.aspirationWindow;
        for (let depth = 1; depth <= maxDepth; depth++) {
            this.followPV = true;
            let score;
            let alpha = depth >= 4 ? bestScore - ASP : -INF;
            let beta = depth >= 4 ? bestScore + ASP : INF;
            let delta = ASP;
            while (true) {
                score = this.negamax(0, depth, alpha, beta);
                if (this.stop)
                    break;
                if (score <= alpha) {
                    alpha = Math.max(-INF, alpha - delta);
                    delta *= 2;
                    continue;
                }
                if (score >= beta) {
                    beta = Math.min(INF, beta + delta);
                    delta *= 2;
                    continue;
                }
                break;
            }
            if (this.stop && depth > 1)
                break;
            bestScore = score;
            if (this.pvLength[0] > 0)
                bestMove = this.pvTable[0][0];
            const elapsed = Math.max(1, Date.now() - this.startTime);
            const pv = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < this.pvLength[0]; i++)
                pv.push((0, movegen_1.moveToUci)(this.pvTable[0][i]));
            if (this.onInfo) {
                this.onInfo({
                    depth, nodes: this.nodes, score: bestScore,
                    timeMs: elapsed, pv, nps: Math.floor(this.nodes * 1000 / elapsed),
                });
            }
            // matestop: keep deepening after the first mate score until depth >= mate plies + 4
            if (Math.abs(bestScore) > tt_1.MATE_BOUND && depth >= (tt_1.MATE_SCORE - Math.abs(bestScore)) + 4)
                break;
            if (Number.isFinite(this.timeLimit) && Date.now() - this.startTime > this.timeLimit * 0.90)
                break;
        }
        return bestMove;
    }
    getPvMove(ply) {
        if (!this.followPV)
            return null;
        if (ply >= this.pvLength[0]) {
            this.followPV = false;
            return null;
        }
        return this.pvTable[0][ply];
    }
    negamax(ply, depth, alpha, beta) {
        this.pvLength[ply] = ply;
        if (ply >= MAX_PLY - 1)
            return (0, evaluate_1.evaluate)(this.board);
        this.nodes++;
        if (ply > 0 && this.isRepetition())
            return 0;
        // drawfix: 50-move rule only if the side to move is not checkmated (mate takes precedence)
        if (this.board.halfmove >= 100) {
            if (this.board.inCheck() && (0, movegen_1.generateLegalMoves)(this.board).length === 0)
                return -tt_1.MATE_SCORE + ply;
            return 0;
        }
        alpha = Math.max(alpha, -tt_1.MATE_SCORE + ply);
        beta = Math.min(beta, tt_1.MATE_SCORE - ply - 1);
        if (alpha >= beta)
            return alpha;
        const inCheck = this.board.inCheck();
        const depthOnEntry = depth;
        if (inCheck && ply < 64 && depth <= 6)
            depth++;
        if (depth <= 0)
            return this.quiescence(ply, alpha, beta);
        if (this.shouldStop())
            return 0;
        const isPV = beta - alpha > 1;
        const ttEntry = this.tt.probe(this.board.zHi, this.board.zLo);
        let ttMove = null;
        if (ttEntry) {
            ttMove = ttEntry.bestMove;
            if (!isPV && ttEntry.depth >= depth) {
                const ttScore = (0, tt_1.scoreFromTT)(ttEntry.score, ply);
                if (ttEntry.flag === 0 /* TTFlag.Exact */)
                    return ttScore;
                if (ttEntry.flag === 1 /* TTFlag.Lower */ && ttScore >= beta)
                    return ttScore;
                if (ttEntry.flag === 2 /* TTFlag.Upper */ && ttScore <= alpha)
                    return ttScore;
            }
        }
        // Internal iterative deepening: root/PV time-gated (short TC skips root IID)
        if (!ttMove && depth >= 6 && !inCheck && (isPV || ply === 0)) {
            const doIid = ply === 0 ? this.allowIidRoot() : this.allowIidTree();
            if (doIid) {
                this.negamax(ply, depth - 2, alpha, beta);
                if (this.stop)
                    return 0;
                const iid = this.tt.probe(this.board.zHi, this.board.zLo);
                if (iid && iid.bestMove)
                    ttMove = iid.bestMove;
            }
        }
        // prune2: static eval at PV nodes too, so improving is correct two plies below a PV node.
        const staticEval = inCheck ? 0 : (0, evaluate_1.evaluate)(this.board);
        if (!inCheck) {
            this.staticAtPly[ply] = staticEval;
            this.staticKnown[ply] = true;
        }
        else {
            this.staticKnown[ply] = false;
        }
        // tteval: refine the pruning eval by the TT bound (SF search.cpp:862); improving stays on raw staticEval
        let ev = staticEval;
        if (!inCheck && ttEntry) {
            const tts = (0, tt_1.scoreFromTT)(ttEntry.score, ply);
            if (Math.abs(tts) < tt_1.MATE_BOUND && (ttEntry.flag === 0 /* TTFlag.Exact */
                || (ttEntry.flag === 1 /* TTFlag.Lower */ && tts > ev) || (ttEntry.flag === 2 /* TTFlag.Upper */ && tts < ev)))
                ev = tts;
        }
        // Razoring (conservative)
        if (!isPV && !inCheck && depth <= 2 && ev + RAZOR_MARGIN[depth] + 50 < alpha) {
            const razor = this.quiescence(ply, alpha, beta);
            if (razor < alpha - 50)
                return razor;
        }
        // Reverse futility (Forge 6.0.0 search.cpp:680): depth<=8, margin 72*d - 40*improving.
        // improving = eval above eval two plies ago; unknown history counts as improving (Forge :665-670).
        if (!isPV && !inCheck && depth <= 8 && Math.abs(beta) < tt_1.MATE_BOUND && ev < tt_1.MATE_BOUND) {
            const rfpImproving = !(ply >= 2 && this.staticKnown[ply - 2]) || staticEval > this.staticAtPly[ply - 2];
            if (ev - (72 * depth - (rfpImproving ? 40 : 0)) >= beta)
                return ev;
        }
        // Null-move pruning
        if (!isPV && !inCheck && depth >= 3 && ev >= beta && ply > 0) {
            const nonPawn = (0, bitboard_1.popcount)(this.board.occupied)
                - (0, bitboard_1.popcount)(this.board.pieceBB[1 /* Piece.WP */])
                - (0, bitboard_1.popcount)(this.board.pieceBB[7 /* Piece.BP */]);
            // pickerlazy2: no null move for a side with only king (+pawns), as in Forge/Stockfish
            // (non_pawn_material(us)); a bare king's null cutoff returns a cp bound that hides the shortest mate.
            const us = this.board.side;
            const usPieces = (0, bitboard_1.popcount)(this.board.colorBB[us])
                - (0, bitboard_1.popcount)(this.board.pieceBB[us === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Piece.WP */ : 7 /* Piece.BP */]);
            // prune2: no two null moves in a row (nullfix-1727 method: top of undoStack is a null move).
            const lastWasNull = this.board.lastMoveIsNull(); // magicflat3: typed undo read, no undoStack rebuild
            if (nonPawn > 2 && usPieces > 1 && !lastWasNull) {
                // prune2: R = 4 + depth/4 + min(3, (staticEval - beta)/200), integer math
                const R = 4 + Math.floor(depth / 4) + Math.min(3, Math.floor((ev - beta) / 200));
                this.board.makeNullMove();
                const score = -this.negamax(ply + 1, depth - 1 - R, -beta, -beta + 1);
                this.board.unmakeNullMove();
                if (this.stop)
                    return 0;
                // Fail-soft NMP (Stockfish-style): return score, not beta, on null-move fail-high
                // prune2: return beta on a null cutoff (never a mate score)
                if (score >= beta)
                    return beta;
            }
        }
        // §8 ProbCut — one depth pair only. Only when side to move is improving.
        // Non-PV, not in check, depth>=5, margin 180, verify at depth-4, <=3 SEE>=0 captures.
        // Shallow search sets inProbCut so ProbCut cannot nest. No check-extension change.
        if (!this.inProbCut && !isPV && !inCheck && depth >= 5
            && Math.abs(beta) < tt_1.MATE_BOUND - 100
            && (ply < 2 || !this.staticKnown[ply] || !this.staticKnown[ply - 2] || staticEval > this.staticAtPly[ply - 2])) {
            const margin = 180;
            const pcBeta = beta + margin;
            const pcDepth = depth - 4;
            let ttBlocks = false;
            if (ttEntry && pcDepth >= 1 && ttEntry.depth >= pcDepth && ttEntry.flag !== 1 /* TTFlag.Lower */) {
                const ts = (0, tt_1.scoreFromTT)(ttEntry.score, ply);
                if (ts < pcBeta)
                    ttBlocks = true;
            }
            if (!ttBlocks && pcDepth >= 1 && pcBeta < tt_1.MATE_BOUND - 50 && ev >= pcBeta) {
                const ranked = [];
                for (const m of (0, movegen_1.generateMoves)(this.board)) {
                    if (m.captured === 0 /* Piece.None */ && m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */)
                        continue;
                    const see = (0, see_1.seeClassic)(this.board, m.from, m.to, m.promo);
                    if (see < 0)
                        continue;
                    const ch = this.capHistory[capIndex(m.piece, m.captured, m.to)] | 0;
                    ranked.push({ m, s: (ch >> 2) + see });
                }
                ranked.sort((a, b) => b.s - a.s);
                const tries = ranked.length < 3 ? ranked.length : 3;
                for (let i = 0; i < tries; i++) {
                    const m = ranked[i].m;
                    if (!this.board.makeMove(m))
                        continue;
                    const sp = this.prevMove;
                    const sp2 = this.prev2Move;
                    this.prev2Move = sp;
                    this.prevMove = m;
                    this.inProbCut = true;
                    const sc = -this.negamax(ply + 1, pcDepth, -pcBeta, -pcBeta + 1);
                    this.inProbCut = false;
                    this.board.unmakeMove();
                    this.prevMove = sp;
                    this.prev2Move = sp2;
                    if (this.stop)
                        return 0;
                    if (sc >= pcBeta) {
                        capGravity(this.capHistory, capIndex(m.piece, m.captured, m.to), capBonus(depth));
                        return sc;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // Singular extension — strict gates (v1.3)
        let seExtend = 0;
        if (!isPV && depth >= 10 && ply > 0 && ttMove && ttEntry
            && ttEntry.depth >= depth - 2
            && ttEntry.flag === 1 /* TTFlag.Lower */
            && Math.abs(ttEntry.score) < tt_1.MATE_BOUND - 100) {
            const ttScore = (0, tt_1.scoreFromTT)(ttEntry.score, ply);
            const singularBeta = ttScore - (2 * depth);
            const reduced = ((depth - 1) >> 1);
            if (reduced >= 1) {
                let seBest = -INF;
                const all = (0, movegen_1.generateMoves)(this.board);
                let tried = 0;
                for (const m of all) {
                    if (this.sameMove(m, ttMove))
                        continue;
                    if (!this.board.makeMove(m))
                        continue;
                    tried++;
                    const sc = -this.negamax(ply + 1, reduced, -singularBeta - 1, -singularBeta);
                    this.board.unmakeMove();
                    if (this.stop)
                        return 0;
                    if (sc > seBest)
                        seBest = sc;
                    if (seBest >= singularBeta)
                        break; // not singular
                }
                if (tried > 0 && seBest < singularBeta)
                    seExtend = 2;
            }
        }
        let moves = (0, movegen_1.generateMoves)(this.board);
        moves = this.orderMoves(moves, ply, ttMove, depth);
        // TT moves are unpacked without a captured piece; resolve capture-ness from the generated move.
        const ttIsCapture = ttMove !== null && moves.some(mm => this.sameMove(mm, ttMove) && mm.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */);
        if (ply === 0 && this.rootQuietRotate > 0) {
            moves = this.rotateRootQuiets(moves, this.rootQuietRotate);
        }
        if (ply === 0 && this.rootDeferPv && depth <= 4 && moves.length > 2) {
            // Move leading candidate to index threadId (mod) so helpers widen early
            const defer = 1 + (this.threadId % Math.min(3, moves.length - 1));
            const head = moves[0];
            moves = moves.slice(1);
            moves.splice(Math.min(defer, moves.length), 0, head);
        }
        let bestScore = -INF;
        let bestMove = null;
        let legalCount = 0;
        let quietCount = 0;
        let flag = 2 /* TTFlag.Upper */;
        const quietsSearched = [];
        // Futility pruning threshold
        const canFutility = !isPV && !inCheck && depth <= 4 && Math.abs(alpha) < tt_1.MATE_BOUND;
        // prune2: late-move pruning (non-PV, not in check, depth<=7); never TT/killer/countermove/check-giving.
        // Skip LMP when the opponent has only king+pawns (mating nets need quiet non-checks).
        const themBB = this.board.colorBB[this.board.side ^ 1];
        const themPawns = this.board.pieceBB[this.board.side === 0 ? 7 /* Piece.BP */ : 1 /* Piece.WP */];
        const canLmp = !isPV && !inCheck && depth <= 7 && ply > 0 && (0, bitboard_1.popcount)(themBB) - (0, bitboard_1.popcount)(themPawns) > 1;
        const lmpImproving = !(ply >= 2 && this.staticKnown[ply - 2]) || staticEval > this.staticAtPly[ply - 2];
        const lmpLimit = Math.floor((3 + depth * depth) / (lmpImproving ? 1 : 2));
        const lmpCm = this.prevMove ? this.countermove[this.prevMove.from * 64 + this.prevMove.to] : null;
        for (let i = 0; i < moves.length; i++) {
            const m = moves[i];
            // SEE pruning of clearly bad captures (skip first 2 captures for safety)
            if (!isPV && !inCheck && m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */ && depth <= 3 && m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */ && legalCount >= 2) {
                const see = m.see !== undefined ? m.see : (0, see_1.seeClassic)(this.board, m.from, m.to);
                if (see < -100 * depth)
                    continue;
            }
            // Futility: skip late quiet moves that can't raise alpha
            if (canFutility && m.captured === 0 /* Piece.None */ && m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */ && legalCount > 3) {
                if (ev + FUTILITY_MARGIN[Math.min(depth, 3)] <= alpha) {
                    quietCount++;
                    if (quietCount > 4 + depth * depth)
                        continue;
                }
            }
            // Tight recapture: SEE>=0, previous move was a capture, same to-square,
            // depth on entry <=4, and this node was not check-extended. Singular wins if both apply.
            let recaptureExt = 0;
            if (depthOnEntry <= 2
                && !(inCheck && ply < 64 && depthOnEntry <= 6)
                && m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */
                && this.prevMove
                && this.prevMove.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */
                && m.to === this.prevMove.to
                && (0, see_1.seeClassic)(this.board, m.from, m.to, m.promo) >= 0)
                recaptureExt = 1;
            if (GC_DEBUG && m.captured === 0 /* Piece.None */ && m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */ && !(m.flags & types_2.MOVE_CASTLE)) {
                const gc = (0, givescheck_1.givesCheckQuiet)(this.board, m);
                if (this.board.makeMove(m)) {
                    exports.gcDebugStats.checked++;
                    if (gc !== this.board.inCheck()) {
                        exports.gcDebugStats.mismatches++;
                        process.stderr.write(`GC_MISMATCH ${this.board.getFen()} ${m.from}-${m.to}\n`);
                    }
                    this.board.unmakeMove();
                }
            }
            // prune2fast: LMP decision before makeMove (identical result: illegal and pruned moves are both skipped).
            let made = false;
            if (canLmp && bestMove !== null && Math.abs(bestScore) < tt_1.MATE_BOUND
                && m.captured === 0 /* Piece.None */ && m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */
                && quietsSearched.length >= lmpLimit
                && !(ttMove && this.sameMove(m, ttMove))
                && !(this.killers[ply][0] && this.sameMove(m, this.killers[ply][0]))
                && !(this.killers[ply][1] && this.sameMove(m, this.killers[ply][1]))
                && !(lmpCm && this.sameMove(m, lmpCm))) {
                if (!(m.flags & types_2.MOVE_CASTLE)) {
                    if (!(0, givescheck_1.givesCheckQuiet)(this.board, m))
                        continue;
                }
                else {
                    // castling: fall back to make + inCheck
                    if (!this.board.makeMove(m))
                        continue;
                    if (!this.board.inCheck()) {
                        this.board.unmakeMove();
                        continue;
                    }
                    made = true;
                }
            }
            if (!made && !this.board.makeMove(m))
                continue;
            legalCount++;
            const rootNodes0 = this.nodes;
            const savedPrev = this.prevMove;
            const savedPrev2 = this.prev2Move;
            this.prev2Move = savedPrev;
            this.prevMove = m;
            const isQuiet = m.captured === 0 /* Piece.None */ && m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */;
            let score;
            // LMR (countermove keyed by parent = savedPrev, not current m)
            if (depth >= 3 && legalCount > (isPV ? 4 : 2) && isQuiet && !inCheck && !this.board.inCheck()) {
                let R = 1 + Math.floor(Math.log(depth) * Math.log(legalCount) / 2.47);
                const isKiller = (this.killers[ply][0] && this.sameMove(m, this.killers[ply][0]))
                    || (this.killers[ply][1] && this.sameMove(m, this.killers[ply][1]));
                const cm = savedPrev ? this.countermove[savedPrev.from * 64 + savedPrev.to] : null;
                const fu = savedPrev2 ? this.followMove[savedPrev2.from * 64 + savedPrev2.to] : null;
                if (isKiller || (cm && this.sameMove(m, cm)) || (fu && this.sameMove(m, fu)))
                    R = Math.max(1, R - 1);
                if (ply >= 2 && this.staticKnown[ply] && this.staticKnown[ply - 2] && staticEval <= this.staticAtPly[ply - 2]) {
                    R = R + 1;
                }
                // No histScore/CMH/FUH in LMR (ordering-only SPRTs)
                if (ttIsCapture)
                    R = R + 1;
                if (ttEntry && ttEntry.flag === 1 /* TTFlag.Lower */)
                    R = R + 1;
                if (isPV)
                    R -= 1;
                if (R < 1)
                    R = 1;
                if (R > depth - 2)
                    R = Math.max(1, depth - 2);
                score = -this.negamax(ply + 1, depth - 1 - R + recaptureExt, -alpha - 1, -alpha);
                if (score > alpha && R > 0) {
                    score = -this.negamax(ply + 1, depth - 1 + recaptureExt, -alpha - 1, -alpha);
                }
                if (score > alpha && score < beta) {
                    score = -this.negamax(ply + 1, depth - 1 + recaptureExt, -beta, -alpha);
                }
            }
            else {
                const singularHere = (legalCount === 1 && seExtend && ttMove && this.sameMove(m, ttMove)) ? seExtend : 0;
                const newDepth = depth - 1 + (singularHere ? singularHere : recaptureExt);
                if (!isPV || legalCount > 1) {
                    score = -this.negamax(ply + 1, newDepth, -alpha - 1, -alpha);
                    if (score > alpha && score < beta) {
                        score = -this.negamax(ply + 1, newDepth, -beta, -alpha);
                    }
                }
                else {
                    score = -this.negamax(ply + 1, newDepth, -beta, -alpha);
                }
            }
            this.board.unmakeMove();
            this.prevMove = savedPrev;
            this.prev2Move = savedPrev2;
            if (ply === 0) {
                const k = rootMoveKey(m);
                this.rootMoveNodes.set(k, (this.rootMoveNodes.get(k) ?? 0) + (this.nodes - rootNodes0));
            }
            if (this.stop)
                return 0;
            if (isQuiet)
                quietsSearched.push(m);
            if (score > bestScore) {
                bestScore = score;
                bestMove = m;
                this.pvTable[ply][ply] = cloneMove(m);
                for (let j = ply + 1; j < this.pvLength[ply + 1]; j++) {
                    this.pvTable[ply][j] = this.pvTable[ply + 1][j];
                }
                this.pvLength[ply] = this.pvLength[ply + 1];
                if (score > alpha) {
                    alpha = score;
                    flag = 0 /* TTFlag.Exact */;
                    if (score >= beta) {
                        flag = 1 /* TTFlag.Lower */;
                        // ProbCut capHistory: smaller bonus on ordinary capture cutoffs (not quiets, not LMR).
                        if (m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */ || m.promo !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
                            capGravity(this.capHistory, capIndex(m.piece, m.captured, m.to), capBonus(depth) >> 1);
                        }
                        if (isQuiet) {
                            if (!this.sameMove(m, this.killers[ply][0])) {
                                this.killers[ply][1] = this.killers[ply][0];
                                this.killers[ply][0] = cloneMove(m);
                            }
                            if (savedPrev) {
                                this.countermove[savedPrev.from * 64 + savedPrev.to] = cloneMove(m);
                            }
                            if (savedPrev2) {
                                this.followMove[savedPrev2.from * 64 + savedPrev2.to] = cloneMove(m);
                            }
                            // Cooler main-history gravity: bonus best quiet, malus prior quiets
                            {
                                const bonus = mainHistBonus(depth);
                                const malus = mainHistMalus(depth);
                                histUpdate(this.history[m.piece], m.to, bonus);
                                for (const q of quietsSearched) {
                                    if (q.from === m.from && q.to === m.to && q.promo === m.promo)
                                        continue;
                                    histUpdate(this.history[q.piece], q.to, -malus);
                                }
                            }
                            // CMH quadratic gravity (ordering-only; no LMR histScore)
                            if (savedPrev) {
                                const cb = cmhBonus(depth);
                                const cm = cmhMalus(depth);
                                histGravity(this.contHistory, cmhIndex(savedPrev.piece, savedPrev.to, m.piece, m.to), cb);
                                for (const q of quietsSearched) {
                                    if (q.from === m.from && q.to === m.to && q.promo === m.promo)
                                        continue;
                                    histGravity(this.contHistory, cmhIndex(savedPrev.piece, savedPrev.to, q.piece, q.to), -cm);
                                }
                            }
                            // FUH ordering-only: own FUH_MAX gravity keyed by prev2Move (savedPrev2)
                            if (savedPrev2) {
                                const fb = fuhBonus(depth);
                                const fm = fuhMalus(depth);
                                fuhGravity(this.followUpHistory, fuhIndex(savedPrev2.piece, savedPrev2.to, m.piece, m.to), fb);
                                for (const q of quietsSearched) {
                                    if (q.from === m.from && q.to === m.to && q.promo === m.promo)
                                        continue;
                                    fuhGravity(this.followUpHistory, fuhIndex(savedPrev2.piece, savedPrev2.to, q.piece, q.to), -fm);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (legalCount === 0) {
            return inCheck ? -tt_1.MATE_SCORE + ply : 0;
        }
        this.tt.store(this.board.zHi, this.board.zLo, depth, (0, tt_1.scoreToTT)(bestScore, ply), flag, bestMove ? cloneMove(bestMove) : null);
        return bestScore;
    }
    quiescence(ply, alpha, beta) {
        this.nodes++;
        if (this.shouldStop())
            return 0;
        if (ply >= MAX_PLY - 1)
            return (0, evaluate_1.evaluate)(this.board);
        // Probe-only TT: reuse deeper search bounds; never store from qsearch
        const ttQ = this.tt.probe(this.board.zHi, this.board.zLo);
        if (ttQ && ttQ.depth >= 1) {
            const ttScore = (0, tt_1.scoreFromTT)(ttQ.score, ply);
            if (ttQ.flag === 0 /* TTFlag.Exact */)
                return ttScore;
            if (ttQ.flag === 1 /* TTFlag.Lower */ && ttScore >= beta)
                return ttScore;
            if (ttQ.flag === 2 /* TTFlag.Upper */ && ttScore <= alpha)
                return ttScore;
        }
        const inCheck = this.board.inCheck();
        let standPat = 0;
        if (!inCheck) {
            standPat = (0, evaluate_1.evaluate)(this.board);
            if (standPat >= beta)
                return standPat; // fail-soft
            if (standPat > alpha)
                alpha = standPat;
        }
        const moves = inCheck ? (0, movegen_1.generateMoves)(this.board) : (0, movegen_1.generateMoves)(this.board, true);
        const ordered = this.orderCaptures(moves, ply);
        let legalCount = 0;
        for (const m of ordered) {
            if (!inCheck && m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
                const gain = types_1.PIECE_VALUES[m.captured] + (m.promo !== 0 /* Piece.None */ ? 800 : 0);
                if (standPat + gain + 180 < alpha)
                    continue;
                if (m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */
                    && types_1.PIECE_VALUES[this.board.squares[m.to]] < types_1.PIECE_VALUES[m.piece]
                    && (0, see_1.seeClassic)(this.board, m.from, m.to) < 0)
                    continue;
            }
            if (!this.board.makeMove(m))
                continue;
            legalCount++;
            const score = -this.quiescence(ply + 1, -beta, -alpha);
            this.board.unmakeMove();
            if (this.stop)
                return 0;
            if (score >= beta)
                return score; // fail-soft
            if (score > alpha)
                alpha = score;
        }
        if (inCheck && legalCount === 0)
            return -tt_1.MATE_SCORE + ply;
        return alpha;
    }
    orderMoves(moves, ply, ttMove, depth) {
        const n = moves.length;
        const scores = this.scoreStack[ply];
        while (scores.length < n)
            scores.push(0);
        const pvMove = this.getPvMove(ply);
        // orderfast: hoist loop invariants; identical scores to the lock's per-move expression.
        const pvF = pvMove ? pvMove.from : -1, pvT = pvMove ? pvMove.to : -1, pvP = pvMove ? pvMove.promo : -1;
        const ttF = ttMove ? ttMove.from : -1, ttT = ttMove ? ttMove.to : -1, ttP = ttMove ? ttMove.promo : -1;
        const kl = this.killers[ply];
        const k0 = kl[0], k1 = kl[1];
        const k0F = k0 ? k0.from : -1, k0T = k0 ? k0.to : -1, k0P = k0 ? k0.promo : -1;
        const k1F = k1 ? k1.from : -1, k1T = k1 ? k1.to : -1, k1P = k1 ? k1.promo : -1;
        const prev = this.prevMove, prev2 = this.prev2Move;
        const cm = prev ? this.countermove[prev.from * 64 + prev.to] : null;
        const cmF = cm ? cm.from : -1, cmT = cm ? cm.to : -1, cmP = cm ? cm.promo : -1;
        const fu = prev2 ? this.followMove[prev2.from * 64 + prev2.to] : null;
        const fuF = fu ? fu.from : -1, fuT = fu ? fu.to : -1, fuP = fu ? fu.promo : -1;
        const cmhBase = prev ? (prev.piece * 64 + prev.to) * 13 * 64 : 0;
        const fuhBase = prev2 ? (prev2.piece * 64 + prev2.to) * 13 * 64 : 0;
        const cont = this.contHistory, fuh = this.followUpHistory, hist = this.history;
        const board = this.board;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const m = moves[i];
            const f = m.from, t = m.to, pr = m.promo;
            let s = 0;
            if (f === pvF && t === pvT && pr === pvP)
                s = 2000000;
            else if (f === ttF && t === ttT && pr === ttP)
                s = 1500000;
            else if (m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
                s = 1000000 + types_1.PIECE_VALUES[m.captured] * 16 - types_1.PIECE_VALUES[m.piece];
                if (pr === 0 /* Piece.None */) {
                    const see = (0, see_1.seeClassic)(board, f, t);
                    m.see = see;
                    s += see;
                    // badcap: SEE<0 captures go after killers/countermove/quiets (Forge-style bad-capture stage)
                    if (see < 0)
                        s -= 3000000;
                }
            }
            else if (pr !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
                s = 900000 + types_1.PIECE_VALUES[pr];
            }
            else if (f === k0F && t === k0T && pr === k0P)
                s = 800000;
            else if (f === k1F && t === k1T && pr === k1P)
                s = 700000;
            else if (f === cmF && t === cmT && pr === cmP)
                s = 650000;
            else if (f === fuF && t === fuT && pr === fuP)
                s = 640000;
            else {
                const pc = m.piece;
                s = hist[pc][t];
                if (prev)
                    s += cont[cmhBase + pc * 64 + t];
                if (prev2)
                    s += fuh[fuhBase + pc * 64 + t] >> 1;
            }
            scores[i] = s;
        }
        // Insertion sort by score descending (in-place on moves)
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            const m = moves[i], sc = scores[i];
            let j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && scores[j] < sc) {
                moves[j + 1] = moves[j];
                scores[j + 1] = scores[j];
                j--;
            }
            moves[j + 1] = m;
            scores[j + 1] = sc;
        }
        return moves;
    }
    orderCaptures(moves, ply = 0) {
        const n = moves.length;
        const scores = this.scoreStack[ply];
        while (scores.length < n)
            scores.push(0);
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            const m = moves[i];
            let s = 0;
            if (m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
                s = 1000000 + types_1.PIECE_VALUES[m.captured] * 16 - types_1.PIECE_VALUES[m.piece];
            }
            if (m.promo !== 0 /* Piece.None */)
                s += 900000 + types_1.PIECE_VALUES[m.promo];
            scores[i] = s;
        }
        for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            const m = moves[i], sc = scores[i];
            let j = i - 1;
            while (j >= 0 && scores[j] < sc) {
                moves[j + 1] = moves[j];
                scores[j + 1] = scores[j];
                j--;
            }
            moves[j + 1] = m;
            scores[j + 1] = sc;
        }
        return moves;
    }
    /** Sprinkle low-amplitude history so helpers order quiet moves differently. */
    seedHistoryNoise(seed) {
        let s = seed | 0;
        for (let p = 1; p < 13; p++) {
            for (let sq = 0; sq < 64; sq++) {
                s = (Math.imul(s, 1664525) + 1013904223) | 0;
                this.history[p][sq] = (s & 0xff) - 128; // -128..127
            }
        }
    }
    /**
     * Rotate non-capture/non-promo moves after the first few forced slots so
     * helpers try different root candidates early (Lazy SMP diversification).
     */
    rotateRootQuiets(moves, rot) {
        if (rot <= 0 || moves.length < 4)
            return moves;
        // Preserve leading TT/PV/captures (scores already ordered); rotate among quiet tail
        let firstQuiet = 0;
        while (firstQuiet < moves.length) {
            const m = moves[firstQuiet];
            if (m.captured === 0 /* Piece.None */ && m.promo === 0 /* Piece.None */)
                break;
            firstQuiet++;
        }
        // Keep one quiet at front for stability; rotate the rest
        const head = moves.slice(0, Math.min(firstQuiet + 1, moves.length));
        const tail = moves.slice(head.length);
        if (tail.length < 2)
            return moves;
        const r = rot % tail.length;
        return head.concat(tail.slice(r), tail.slice(0, r));
    }
    sameMove(a, b) {
        if (!a || !b)
            return false;
        return a.from === b.from && a.to === b.to && a.promo === b.promo;
    }
    isRepetition() {
        // g4g1g5+rephist3: in-tree scan via typed undo (board.isRepetitionKey); then true 3-fold via rootHist.
        // isRepetitionKey returns false on irreversible-in-tree OR no match; either way rootHist is safe
        // (irreversible changes material/pawns so current key cannot match pre-root hist).
        const hi = this.board.zHi, lo = this.board.zLo;
        if (this.board.isRepetitionKey(hi, lo))
            return true;
        // rephist3 (Stockfish rule): no in-tree repeat -> pre-root game position is draw only at true 3-fold.
        const rh = this.rootHistHi, rl = this.rootHistLo;
        if (rh && rl) {
            let cnt = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < rh.length; i++)
                if (rh[i] === hi && rl[i] === lo && ++cnt >= 2)
                    return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}
exports.Search = Search;

"use strict";
/** Static Exchange Evaluation */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.see = see;

exports.seeGe = seeGe;
const types_1 = require("../board/types");
const bitboard_1 = require("../board/bitboard");
const attacks_1 = require("../board/attacks");
const magics_1 = require("../board/magics");
const VAL = [0, 100, 320, 330, 500, 900, 20000, 100, 320, 330, 500, 900, 20000];
const GAIN = new Array(32);
/** SEE for move from→to. Returns net material for side to move. */
function see(board, from, to, promo = 0 /* Piece.None */) {
    return seeClassic(board, from, to, promo);
}
/** Classic iterative SEE with reusable gain buffer; scalar lo/hi, no bitboard object allocation */
function seeClassic(board, from, to, promo = 0 /* Piece.None */) {
    const gain = GAIN;
    let d = 0;
    const captured = board.squares[to];
    gain[d] = captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */ ? VAL[captured] : 0;
    if (promo)
        gain[d] += VAL[promo] - 100;
    const bt = bitboard_1.BIT_TABLE;
    const occ0 = board.occupied;
    let oLo = occ0.lo, oHi = occ0.hi;
    const fb = bt[from];
    oLo = (oLo ^ fb.lo) >>> 0;
    oHi = (oHi ^ fb.hi) >>> 0;
    if (captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */) {
        const tb = bt[to];
        oLo = (oLo ^ tb.lo) >>> 0;
        oHi = (oHi ^ tb.hi) >>> 0;
    }
    let side = board.side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? 1 /* Color.Black */ : 0 /* Color.White */;
    const pbb = board.pieceBB, cbb = board.colorBB;
    // static (occupancy independent) attackers
    const sp1 = attacks_1.BLACK_PAWN_ATTACKS[to], sp2 = attacks_1.WHITE_PAWN_ATTACKS[to], kn = attacks_1.KNIGHT_ATTACKS[to], kg = attacks_1.KING_ATTACKS[to];
    const wp = pbb[1 /* Piece.WP */], bp = pbb[7 /* Piece.BP */], wn = pbb[2 /* Piece.WN */], bn = pbb[8 /* Piece.BN */], wk = pbb[6 /* Piece.WK */], bk = pbb[12 /* Piece.BK */];
    const stLo = ((sp1.lo & wp.lo) | (sp2.lo & bp.lo) | (kn.lo & (wn.lo | bn.lo)) | (kg.lo & (wk.lo | bk.lo))) >>> 0;
    const stHi = ((sp1.hi & wp.hi) | (sp2.hi & bp.hi) | (kn.hi & (wn.hi | bn.hi)) | (kg.hi & (wk.hi | bk.hi))) >>> 0;
    const diagLo = (pbb[3 /* Piece.WB */].lo | pbb[9 /* Piece.BB */].lo | pbb[5 /* Piece.WQ */].lo | pbb[11 /* Piece.BQ */].lo) >>> 0;
    const diagHi = (pbb[3 /* Piece.WB */].hi | pbb[9 /* Piece.BB */].hi | pbb[5 /* Piece.WQ */].hi | pbb[11 /* Piece.BQ */].hi) >>> 0;
    const orthLo = (pbb[4 /* Piece.WR */].lo | pbb[10 /* Piece.BR */].lo | pbb[5 /* Piece.WQ */].lo | pbb[11 /* Piece.BQ */].lo) >>> 0;
    const orthHi = (pbb[4 /* Piece.WR */].hi | pbb[10 /* Piece.BR */].hi | pbb[5 /* Piece.WQ */].hi | pbb[11 /* Piece.BQ */].hi) >>> 0;
    const BL = magics_1.BISHOP_LO, BH = magics_1.BISHOP_HI, RL = magics_1.ROOK_LO, RH = magics_1.ROOK_HI;
    let aLo, aHi;
    {
        const bi = (0, magics_1.bishopIdx)(to, oLo, oHi), ri = (0, magics_1.rookIdx)(to, oLo, oHi);
        aLo = (stLo | (BL[bi] & diagLo) | (RL[ri] & orthLo)) >>> 0;
        aHi = (stHi | (BH[bi] & diagHi) | (RH[ri] & orthHi)) >>> 0;
    }
    let movedPiece = promo || board.squares[from];
    while (true) {
        d++;
        gain[d] = VAL[movedPiece] - gain[d - 1];
        aLo = (aLo & oLo) >>> 0;
        aHi = (aHi & oHi) >>> 0;
        const c = cbb[side];
        const myLo = (aLo & c.lo) >>> 0, myHi = (aHi & c.hi) >>> 0;
        if (myLo === 0 && myHi === 0)
            break;
        let bestSq = -1;
        let bestPiece = 0;
        for (let pt = 1; pt <= 6; pt++) {
            const p = side === 0 /* Color.White */ ? pt : pt + 6;
            const pb = pbb[p];
            const l = (myLo & pb.lo) >>> 0, h = (myHi & pb.hi) >>> 0;
            if (l !== 0 || h !== 0) {
                bestSq = l !== 0 ? 31 - Math.clz32(l & -l) : 32 + 31 - Math.clz32(h & -h);
                bestPiece = p;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (bestSq < 0)
            break;
        const bb2 = bt[bestSq];
        oLo = (oLo ^ bb2.lo) >>> 0;
        oHi = (oHi ^ bb2.hi) >>> 0;
        // X-rays: always recompute sliders
        const bi = (0, magics_1.bishopIdx)(to, oLo, oHi), ri = (0, magics_1.rookIdx)(to, oLo, oHi);
        aLo = (stLo | (BL[bi] & diagLo) | (RL[ri] & orthLo)) >>> 0;
        aHi = (stHi | (BH[bi] & diagHi) | (RH[ri] & orthHi)) >>> 0;
        side = 1 - side;
        movedPiece = bestPiece;
        if ((0, types_1.pieceType)(bestPiece) === 6)
            break;
        if (d >= 31)
            break;
    }
    while (--d) {
        gain[d - 1] = -Math.max(-gain[d - 1], gain[d]);
    }
    return gain[0];
}
/** True if SEE >= threshold (avoids full fold when possible via early reject). */
function seeGe(board, from, to, threshold, promo = 0 /* Piece.None */) {
    return seeClassic(board, from, to, promo) >= threshold;
}

/** Lazy SMP manager — warm persistent worker pool + cooperative stop. */
const worker_threads_1 = require("worker_threads");
const path = __importStar(require("path"));
const movegen_1 = require("../move/movegen");
const tt_1 = require("./tt");
/**
 * rephist3: keys of game positions before the root that can still repeat, i.e. positions reached
 * AFTER the last capture or pawn move (halfmove clock 0). The position before an irreversible move
 * is excluded, as is everything earlier. Ordered newest first.
 */
function buildRootHist(board) {
    const histHi = [], histLo = [];
    for (let i = board.undoStack.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const u = board.undoStack[i];
        const m = u.move;
        if (m.captured !== 0 /* Piece.None */ || m.piece === 1 /* Piece.WP */ || m.piece === 7 /* Piece.BP */)
            break;
        histHi.push(u.zHi);
        histLo.push(u.zLo);
    }
    return { hi: Int32Array.from(histHi), lo: Int32Array.from(histLo) };
}
const WORKER_PATH = path.join(__dirname, 'smp_worker.js');
/** Persistent helper pool (reused across go commands). */
let pool = [];
let poolReady = [];
let activeStopFlag = null;
let activeMain = null;
let busyWorkers = [];
/** One shared TT for Lazy SMP (persists across go; cleared on ucinewgame). */
let sharedBundle = null;
/** hashmb: TT entries from UCI Hash (16 nominal bytes/entry, rounded down to a power of two; Hash=64 -> 1<<22 = old default). */
let hashEntries = tt_1.TT_SIZE;
function hashMbToEntries(mb) {
    const m = Math.max(1, Math.min(1024, mb | 0));
    const want = Math.floor((m * 1024 * 1024) / 16);
    let e = 1;
    while (e * 2 <= want)
        e *= 2;
    return e;
}
/** hashmb: apply UCI Hash to the shared SMP table and every worker's local table. Call between searches. */
function setHashMb(mb) {
    const e = hashMbToEntries(mb);
    if (e === hashEntries)
        return;
    hashEntries = e;
    sharedBundle = null; // recreated lazily at the new size
    for (const w of pool) {
        try {
            w.postMessage({ type: 'hash', entries: e });
        }
        catch { /* */ }
    }
}
function getSharedBundle() {
    if (!sharedBundle)
        sharedBundle = (0, tt_1.createSharedTTBundle)(hashEntries);
    return sharedBundle;
}
function clearSharedTT() {
    if (!sharedBundle)
        return;
    const tt = new tt_1.TranspositionTable(sharedBundle.size, sharedBundle);
    tt.clear();
}
/** ttkeep: clear each worker's persistent local TT (ucinewgame). Message order guarantees it lands before the next job. */
function clearWorkerTTs() {
    for (const w of pool) {
        try {
            w.postMessage({ type: 'newgame' });
        }
        catch { /* */ }
    }
}
function abortSmpSearch() {
    if (activeStopFlag) {
        try {
            Atomics.store(activeStopFlag, 0, 1);
        }
        catch { /* */ }
    }
    if (activeMain)
        activeMain.stop = true;
    for (const w of busyWorkers) {
        try {
            w.postMessage({ type: 'stop' });
        }
        catch { /* */ }
    }
}
function clearActive() {
    activeStopFlag = null;
    activeMain = null;
    busyWorkers = [];
}
/** NNUE config pushed to every worker (current + future). */
let nnueCfg = null;
function setPoolNNUE(use, file) {
    file = file ?? nnueCfg?.file ?? null;
    nnueCfg = { use, file };
    for (const w of pool) {
        try {
            w.postMessage({ type: 'nnue', use, file });
        }
        catch { /* */ }
    }
}
/** Ask every worker for its nnueInfo (testing / `nnueinfo` UCI debug command). */
let nnueQueryId = 0;
function queryPoolNNUE() {
    const qid = ++nnueQueryId;
    return Promise.all(pool.map((w, i) => new Promise((resolve) => {
        const onMsg = (msg) => {
            if (msg && msg.type === 'nnueinfo' && msg.qid === qid) {
                w.off('message', onMsg);
                resolve(`worker ${i}: ${msg.info}`);
            }
        };
        w.on('message', onMsg);
        try {
            w.postMessage({ type: 'nnueinfo', qid });
        }
        catch {
            resolve(`worker ${i}: unreachable`);
        }
    })));
}
/** Ensure at least `n` warm workers (all search threads, including main). */
async function ensurePool(n) {
    const need = Math.max(0, Math.min(8, n | 0));
    while (pool.length < need) {
        const idx = pool.length;
        const w = new worker_threads_1.Worker(WORKER_PATH);
        const ready = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const onMsg = (msg) => {
                if (msg && (msg.type === 'boot' || msg.type === 'ready')) {
                    w.off('message', onMsg);
                    resolve();
                }
            };
            w.on('message', onMsg);
            w.on('error', reject);
            // Ask for explicit ready after boot
            if (nnueCfg)
                w.postMessage({ type: 'nnue', use: nnueCfg.use, file: nnueCfg.file });
            w.postMessage({ type: 'warmup', entries: hashEntries });
        });
        pool.push(w);
        poolReady.push(ready);
    }
    await Promise.all(poolReady.slice(0, need));
}
async function shutdownPool() {
    const ws = pool.slice();
    pool = [];
    poolReady = [];
    for (const w of ws) {
        try {
            w.postMessage({ type: 'shutdown' });
        }
        catch { /* */ }
        try {
            w.removeAllListeners();
        }
        catch { /* */ }
        try {
            await w.terminate();
        }
        catch { /* */ }
    }
}
/**
 * Prefer main (thread 0). Take a helper only if strictly deeper and not a
 * clear score regression — avoids Lazy-SMP "deeper-but-wrong" blunders at short TC.
 */
function pickBest(results) {
    const main = results.find(r => r.threadId === 0) || results[0];
    let best = main;
    for (const r of results) {
        if (r.threadId === 0)
            continue;
        const deepEnough = r.depth >= main.depth + 2;
        const deeperOkScore = r.depth > main.depth && r.score >= main.score - 30;
        if (!deepEnough && !deeperOkScore)
            continue;
        if (r.depth > best.depth || (r.depth === best.depth && r.score > best.score)) {
            best = r;
        }
    }
    return best;
}
function helperGraceMs(limits) {
    if (limits.moveTime !== undefined) {
        return Math.min(400, Math.max(80, Math.floor(limits.moveTime * 0.25) + 50));
    }
    return 300;
}
/**
 * Lazy SMP: ALL threads (including main/thread 0) run in warm workers.
 * UCI stays on the Node event loop so `stop` can set the SAB flag / postMessage.
 * Thread 0 posts info; helpers share TT and diversify mildly.
 */
async function searchLazySmp(board, limits, threads, onInfo) {
    const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(8, threads | 0));
    const sab = new SharedArrayBuffer(4);
    const stopFlag = new Int32Array(sab);
    Atomics.store(stopFlag, 0, 0);
    activeStopFlag = stopFlag;
    activeMain = null;
    await ensurePool(n);
    const fen = board.getFen();
    // rephist3: game-history keys strictly after the last irreversible move (capture or pawn move)
    const { hi: rootHistHi, lo: rootHistLo } = buildRootHist(board);
    const workers = pool.slice(0, n);
    busyWorkers = workers.slice();
    const results = [];
    const useSharedTT = n > 1;
    const bundle = useSharedTT ? getSharedBundle() : null;
    let mainDepth = 0, mainScore = 0, mainPv = [];
    let mainNodes = 0;
    let bestMainUci = null;
    const donePromises = workers.map((w, threadId) => {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            let settled = false;
            const finish = () => { if (!settled) {
                settled = true;
                resolve();
            } };
            const onMsg = (msg) => {
                if (msg.type === 'info' && threadId === 0) {
                    mainDepth = msg.depth;
                    mainScore = msg.score;
                    mainPv = msg.pv || [];
                    mainNodes = msg.nodes;
                    onInfo?.({
                        depth: msg.depth,
                        score: msg.score,
                        nodes: msg.nodes,
                        nps: msg.nps || 0,
                        timeMs: msg.timeMs || 0,
                        pv: msg.pv || [],
                        bestFrac: msg.bestFrac,
                    });
                    return;
                }
                if (msg.type === 'done' && msg.threadId === threadId) {
                    w.off('message', onMsg);
                    results.push({
                        threadId: msg.threadId,
                        best: msg.best,
                        depth: msg.depth,
                        score: msg.score,
                        nodes: msg.nodes,
                        pv: msg.pv || [],
                    });
                    if (threadId === 0) {
                        bestMainUci = msg.best;
                        mainDepth = msg.depth;
                        mainScore = msg.score;
                        mainPv = msg.pv || [];
                        mainNodes = msg.nodes;
                    }
                    finish();
                }
            };
            w.on('message', onMsg);
            const job = {
                type: 'search',
                fen,
                rootHistHi,
                rootHistLo,
                limits: { ...limits },
                threadId,
                stopSab: sab,
            };
            if (bundle)
                job.ttBundle = bundle;
            w.postMessage(job);
        });
    });
    // Await main (thread 0) — required for a legal bestmove
    try {
        await donePromises[0];
    }
    finally {
        Atomics.store(stopFlag, 0, 1);
        for (const w of workers) {
            try {
                w.postMessage({ type: 'stop' });
            }
            catch { /* */ }
        }
    }
    if (n > 1) {
        const timed = limits.moveTime !== undefined || limits.wtime !== undefined || limits.btime !== undefined;
        const waitMs = timed ? helperGraceMs(limits) : 180000;
        await new Promise((resolve) => {
            let done = false;
            const finish = () => {
                if (done)
                    return;
                done = true;
                clearTimeout(timer);
                resolve();
            };
            const timer = setTimeout(finish, waitMs);
            Promise.all(donePromises.slice(1)).then(finish).catch(finish);
        });
    }
    clearActive();
    const pick = pickBest(results.length ? results : [{
            threadId: 0,
            best: bestMainUci,
            depth: mainDepth,
            score: mainScore,
            nodes: mainNodes,
            pv: mainPv,
        }]);
    const totalNodes = results.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.nodes || 0), 0);
    let best = null;
    if (pick.best)
        best = (0, movegen_1.parseUciMove)(board, pick.best);
    if (!best && bestMainUci)
        best = (0, movegen_1.parseUciMove)(board, bestMainUci);
    return {
        best,
        nodes: totalNodes || mainNodes,
        depth: pick.depth,
        score: pick.score,
        pv: pick.pv,
    };
}

"use strict";
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
/**
 * Persistent Lazy-SMP worker (thread 0 + helpers).
 * Loads modules once, then loops on {type:'search'} jobs until {type:'shutdown'}.
 * Thread 0 posts UCI info; helpers only return final results.
 * Search runs OFF the UCI thread so `stop` can set the SAB Atomics flag.
 */
const worker_threads_1 = require("worker_threads");
const board_1 = require("../board/board");
const search_1 = require("./search");
const movegen_1 = require("../move/movegen");
const tt_1 = require("./tt");
const nnue_1 = require("../eval/nnue");
let activeSearch = null;
/**
 * ttkeep: one Search (and its local 1<<22 TT) per worker, reused across `go`.
 * Previously every job did `new Search(board)`, allocating a fresh 4M-entry TT
 * (~20-30 ms) that was discarded after the move. History/killers are still
 * reset per search by Search.search() -> resetHeuristics() (unchanged 1.7.26
 * behaviour); TT age is bumped per search by tt.prefetchAge().
 */
let persistentSearch = null;
let localTT = null;
/** hashmb: local TT size requested by UCI Hash (default = TT_SIZE, the lock's 1<<22). */
let wantEntries = 0;
function applyHash(entries) {
    if (!(entries > 0))
        return;
    wantEntries = entries;
    if (persistentSearch && persistentSearch.tt.size !== entries) {
        localTT = new tt_1.TranspositionTable(entries);
        persistentSearch.tt = localTT;
    }
}
function getSearch(fen) {
    const board = new board_1.Board(fen);
    if (!persistentSearch) {
        persistentSearch = new search_1.Search(board);
        localTT = persistentSearch.tt;
        if (wantEntries > 0 && localTT.size !== wantEntries) {
            localTT = new tt_1.TranspositionTable(wantEntries);
            persistentSearch.tt = localTT;
        }
    }
    else {
        persistentSearch.board = board;
    }
    return persistentSearch;
}
worker_threads_1.parentPort?.on('message', (msg) => {
    if (!msg || typeof msg !== 'object')
        return;
    if (msg.type === 'hash') {
        applyHash(msg.entries);
        return;
    }
    if (msg.type === 'warmup') {
        if (msg.entries)
            wantEntries = msg.entries;
        getSearch('rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1');
        worker_threads_1.parentPort?.postMessage({ type: 'ready' });
        return;
    }
    if (msg.type === 'nnue') {
        if (msg.file)
            (0, nnue_1.loadNet)(msg.file);
        (0, nnue_1.setUseNNUE)(msg.use);
        return;
    }
    if (msg.type === 'nnueinfo') {
        worker_threads_1.parentPort?.postMessage({ type: 'nnueinfo', qid: msg.qid, info: (0, nnue_1.nnueInfo)() });
        return;
    }
    if (msg.type === 'newgame') {
        if (localTT)
            localTT.clear();
        return;
    }
    if (msg.type === 'stop') {
        if (activeSearch)
            activeSearch.stop = true;
        return;
    }
    if (msg.type === 'shutdown') {
        if (activeSearch)
            activeSearch.stop = true;
        setImmediate(() => process.exit(0));
        return;
    }
    if (msg.type === 'search') {
        const stopFlag = new Int32Array(msg.stopSab);
        const search = getSearch(msg.fen);
        search.rootHistHi = msg.rootHistHi ?? null;
        search.rootHistLo = msg.rootHistLo ?? null;
        activeSearch = search;
        search.stopFlag = stopFlag;
        search.threadId = msg.threadId;
        if (msg.ttBundle) {
            search.tt = new tt_1.TranspositionTable(msg.ttBundle.size, msg.ttBundle);
        }
        else if (localTT) {
            search.tt = localTT;
        }
        const isMain = msg.threadId === 0;
        if (!isMain) {
            /*
             * With shared TT, mild diversification only (classic Lazy SMP):
             * skip root IID + slight aspiration skew. Avoid heavy rootDefer/history
             * noise that previously made helpers return deeper-but-worse moves.
             */
            search.skipRootIid = true;
            search.aspirationWindow = 45 + 10 * msg.threadId;
            search.historyNoiseSeed = 0;
            search.rootQuietRotate = 0;
            search.rootDeferPv = false;
        }
        let lastDepth = 0;
        let lastScore = 0;
        let lastPv = [];
        search.onInfo = (info) => {
            lastDepth = info.depth;
            lastScore = info.score;
            lastPv = info.pv;
            if (isMain) {
                worker_threads_1.parentPort?.postMessage({
                    type: 'info',
                    threadId: 0,
                    depth: info.depth,
                    score: info.score,
                    nodes: info.nodes,
                    nps: info.nps,
                    timeMs: info.timeMs,
                    pv: info.pv,
                    bestFrac: rootBestFrac(search),
                });
            }
        };
        try {
            const best = search.search(msg.limits);
            worker_threads_1.parentPort?.postMessage({
                type: 'done',
                threadId: msg.threadId,
                best: best ? (0, movegen_1.moveToUci)(best) : null,
                depth: lastDepth,
                score: lastScore,
                nodes: search.nodes,
                pv: lastPv,
            });
        }
        catch (e) {
            worker_threads_1.parentPort?.postMessage({
                type: 'done',
                threadId: msg.threadId,
                best: null,
                depth: lastDepth,
                score: lastScore,
                nodes: search.nodes,
                pv: lastPv,
                error: String(e),
            });
        }
        finally {
            activeSearch = null;
        }
    }
});
worker_threads_1.parentPort?.postMessage({ type: 'boot' });
/** tm-forge-1726: share of root nodes spent under the current best (PV) move; undefined if unknown. */
function rootBestFrac(s) {
    if (s.pvLength[0] <= 0)
        return undefined;
    let total = 0;
    for (const v of s.rootMoveNodes.values())
        total += v;
    if (total <= 0)
        return undefined;
    return (s.rootMoveNodes.get((0, search_1.rootMoveKey)(s.pvTable[0][0])) ?? 0) / total;
}

## search/timeman.js
```js
"use strict";
/** Time management v2 (UCI layer). Pure functions, no search.ts dependency.
 *  hard limit: enforced by a main-thread timer through the shared stop flag (precise, not 4096-node polling).
 *  soft limit: checked after each completed iteration (info callback); scaled by best-move stability and score drop. */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.SoftController = void 0;
exports.effectiveOverhead = effectiveOverhead;
exports.computeBudget = computeBudget;
/** tm-forge-1726: without movestogo, soft = usable/22 + 0.75*inc, hard = min(0.6*usable, 5*soft).
 *  (Replaces the old movestogo=28 assumption; explicit movestogo keeps the old formula.) */
const FORGE_DIV = 22;
const FORGE_HARD_FRAC = 0.6;
const FORGE_HARD_MULT = 5;
/** Node-fraction scaling applies from this completed depth on. */
const NODE_TM_MIN_DEPTH = 6;
/** Wall time between the soft-stop decision and bestmove reaching the GUI (measured, see permove log). */
const STOP_LATENCY_MS = 10;
/** Overhead per move: UCI option plus extra allowance at short time controls (process scheduling, pipe latency). */
function effectiveOverhead(time, moveOverhead) {
    const mo = Math.max(0, moveOverhead);
    if (time < 1500)
        return mo + 40;
    if (time < 5000)
        return mo + 25;
    if (time < 15000)
        return mo + 10;
    return mo;
}
function computeBudget(inp) {
    const time = Math.max(0, inp.time ?? 0);
    const inc = Math.max(0, inp.inc ?? 0);
    const ovh = effectiveOverhead(time, inp.moveOverhead);
    const mtgGiven = inp.movestogo !== undefined && inp.movestogo > 0;
    const usable = Math.max(0, time - ovh);
    let soft;
    let hard;
    if (mtgGiven) {
        // unchanged movestogo handling
        const mtg = Math.min(inp.movestogo, 60);
        soft = usable / mtg + inc * 0.75;
        // fraction of the clock we allow ourselves on hard: ~40%, rises as the control nears (last moves before time control)
        const frac = mtg <= 2 ? (mtg === 1 ? 0.8 : 0.55) : 0.4;
        hard = Math.min(soft * 3.2, usable * frac);
    }
    else {
        soft = usable / FORGE_DIV + inc * 0.75;
        hard = Math.min(usable * FORGE_HARD_FRAC, soft * FORGE_HARD_MULT);
    }
    // never spend more than the clock minus overhead (incl. the increment we get back only after moving)
    const ceiling = Math.max(0, usable - 5);
    soft = Math.min(soft, hard * 0.8, ceiling);
    hard = Math.min(hard, ceiling);
    // safe floors, but never exceeding what is left
    const floor = Math.min(15, Math.max(1, Math.floor(usable * 0.5)));
    if (hard < floor)
        hard = floor;
    if (soft < floor * 0.6)
        soft = floor * 0.6;
    if (soft > hard)
        soft = hard;
    return { soft: Math.floor(soft), hard: Math.floor(hard) };
}
/** Per-search dynamic soft-limit state. Feed it each completed iteration. */
class SoftController {
    constructor(budget) {
        this.budget = budget;
        this.prevMove = '';
        this.stable = 0;
        this.prevScore = 0;
        this.dropBonus = 1;
    }
    /** returns true if the search should stop now (after this completed iteration). */
    /** bestFrac = rootMoveNodes[best] / sum(rootMoveNodes) for this search (undefined if unavailable). */
    onIteration(depth, score, bestUci, elapsed, bestFrac) {
        if (bestUci === this.prevMove)
            this.stable++;
        else {
            this.stable = 0;
        }
        if (depth > 1 && score < this.prevScore - 25)
            this.dropBonus = Math.min(1.6, this.dropBonus + 0.25);
        else
            this.dropBonus = Math.max(1, this.dropBonus - 0.1);
        this.prevMove = bestUci;
        this.prevScore = score;
        // tm-forge-1726 v2: no "always reach depth 4" floor. At bullet clocks (soft ~25-50 ms) depth 4 alone
        // cost 30-60 ms and every move overran soft (see research/tm_forge_1726_permove.log). Shallow iterations
        // now use the same next-iteration prediction with neutral stability (stable counts mean little there).
        const stabFactor = depth < 4 ? 1.0 : [1.35, 1.15, 1.0, 0.9, 0.8, 0.72][Math.min(this.stable, 5)];
        // tm-forge-1726: node-fraction scaling (best move took most of the root effort -> stop earlier).
        // Kept alongside stability/drop: stability tracks PV changes across iterations, node fraction tracks
        // effort split inside them; Forge/SF-style engines combine both. Product is still capped below hard.
        let nodeFactor = 1;
        if (depth >= NODE_TM_MIN_DEPTH && bestFrac !== undefined && Number.isFinite(bestFrac)) {
            nodeFactor = Math.min(1.4, Math.max(0.6, 1.55 - bestFrac));
        }
        const target = Math.min(this.budget.hard * 0.9, this.budget.soft * nodeFactor * stabFactor * this.dropBonus);
        // next iteration typically costs ~2x: stop if we would not finish it within target
        // + fixed post-iteration latency (abort, worker message, bestmove) measured ~10-17 ms wall
        // Shallow iterations (depth < 4) are cheap relative to the fixed latency, so only stop once the target
        // itself is reached; deeper ones keep the ~2x next-iteration prediction.
        return elapsed + STOP_LATENCY_MS >= target * (depth < 4 ? 1.0 : 0.55);
    }
}
exports.SoftController = SoftController;
//# sourceMappingURL=timeman.js.map```

## search/tt.js
```js
"use strict";
/** Transposition table — packed entries; optional SharedArrayBuffer for Lazy SMP */
Object.defineProperty(exports, "__esModule", { value: true });
exports.MATE_BOUND = exports.MATE_SCORE = exports.TranspositionTable = exports.TT_SIZE = void 0;
exports.createSharedTTBundle = createSharedTTBundle;
exports.packMove = packMove;
exports.unpackMove = unpackMove;
exports.scoreToTT = scoreToTT;
exports.scoreFromTT = scoreFromTT;
/** Default 4M entries; shared SMP uses same. */
exports.TT_SIZE = 1 << 22;
function createSharedTTBundle(size = exports.TT_SIZE) {
    const depthsSab = new SharedArrayBuffer(size);
    new Int8Array(depthsSab).fill(-1);
    return {
        size,
        keysHiSab: new SharedArrayBuffer(size * 4),
        keysLoSab: new SharedArrayBuffer(size * 4),
        depthsSab,
        scoresSab: new SharedArrayBuffer(size * 2),
        flagsSab: new SharedArrayBuffer(size),
        agesSab: new SharedArrayBuffer(size),
        movesSab: new SharedArrayBuffer(size * 4),
        metaSab: new SharedArrayBuffer(4),
    };
}
/** Pack from/to/promo; 0 = null. sameMove only needs these fields. */
function packMove(m) {
    if (!m)
        return 0;
    return (1 + m.from + (m.to << 6) + ((m.promo & 15) << 12)) >>> 0;
}
function unpackMove(code) {
    if (!code)
        return null;
    const v = (code - 1) >>> 0;
    return {
        from: v & 63,
        to: (v >>> 6) & 63,
        promo: (v >>> 12) & 15,
        piece: 0 /* Piece.None */,
        captured: 0 /* Piece.None */,
        flags: 0,
    };
}
class TranspositionTable {
    constructor(size = exports.TT_SIZE, bundle) {
        /** Optional object cache for local TT only (unused when shared). */
        this.moves = null;
        this.age = 0;
        this.sharedMeta = null;
        this.isShared = false;
        if (bundle) {
            this.size = bundle.size;
            this.keysHi = new Int32Array(bundle.keysHiSab);
            this.keysLo = new Int32Array(bundle.keysLoSab);
            this.depths = new Int8Array(bundle.depthsSab);
            this.scores = new Int16Array(bundle.scoresSab);
            this.flags = new Uint8Array(bundle.flagsSab);
            this.ages = new Uint8Array(bundle.agesSab);
            this.moveCodes = new Uint32Array(bundle.movesSab);
            this.sharedMeta = new Int32Array(bundle.metaSab);
            this.isShared = true;
            this.age = Atomics.load(this.sharedMeta, 0) & 255;
        }
        else {
            this.size = size;
            this.keysHi = new Int32Array(size);
            this.keysLo = new Int32Array(size);
            this.depths = new Int8Array(size);
            this.scores = new Int16Array(size);
            this.flags = new Uint8Array(size);
            this.ages = new Uint8Array(size);
            this.moveCodes = new Uint32Array(size);
            this.depths.fill(-1);
        }
    }
    clear() {
        this.depths.fill(-1);
        this.moveCodes.fill(0);
        this.keysHi.fill(0);
        this.keysLo.fill(0);
        this.scores.fill(0);
        this.flags.fill(0);
        this.ages.fill(0);
        this.age = 0;
        if (this.sharedMeta)
            Atomics.store(this.sharedMeta, 0, 0);
    }
    index(lo) {
        return lo & (this.size - 1);
    }
    probe(hi, lo) {
        const i = lo & (this.size - 1);
        if (this.keysLo[i] === lo && this.keysHi[i] === hi && this.depths[i] >= 0) {
            return {
                hi, lo,
                depth: this.depths[i],
                score: this.scores[i],
                flag: this.flags[i],
                bestMove: unpackMove(this.moveCodes[i]),
                age: this.ages[i],
            };
        }
        return null;
    }
    store(hi, lo, depth, score, flag, bestMove) {
        const i = lo & (this.size - 1);
        const curD = this.depths[i];
        const same = this.keysLo[i] === lo && this.keysHi[i] === hi && curD >= 0;
        if (same && depth < curD && flag !== 0 /* TTFlag.Exact */) {
            if (!this.moveCodes[i] && bestMove)
                this.moveCodes[i] = packMove(bestMove);
            return;
        }
        if (same && depth < curD) {
            if (!this.moveCodes[i] && bestMove)
                this.moveCodes[i] = packMove(bestMove);
            return;
        }
        // ttkeep: wrap-safe generation distance (age is 8-bit and now persists across go)
        if (!same && curD >= 0 && depth < curD && ((this.age - this.ages[i]) & 255) <= 2 && flag !== 0 /* TTFlag.Exact */) {
            return;
        }
        // Racy writes OK for Lazy SMP — last writer wins
        this.keysHi[i] = hi;
        this.keysLo[i] = lo;
        this.depths[i] = depth > 127 ? 127 : depth;
        this.scores[i] = score > 32767 ? 32767 : score < -32768 ? -32768 : score;
        this.flags[i] = flag;
        this.moveCodes[i] = packMove(bestMove);
        this.ages[i] = this.age & 255;
    }
    prefetchAge() {
        if (this.sharedMeta) {
            // Approximate age bump; races are fine for replacement policy
            let a = (Atomics.load(this.sharedMeta, 0) + 1) & 255;
            Atomics.store(this.sharedMeta, 0, a);
            this.age = a;
        }
        else {
            this.age = (this.age + 1) & 255;
        }
    }
}
exports.TranspositionTable = TranspositionTable;
exports.MATE_SCORE = 30000;
exports.MATE_BOUND = 29000;
function scoreToTT(score, ply) {
    if (score > exports.MATE_BOUND)
        return score + ply;
    if (score < -exports.MATE_BOUND)
        return score - ply;
    return score;
}
function scoreFromTT(score, ply) {
    if (score > exports.MATE_BOUND)
        return score - ply;
    if (score < -exports.MATE_BOUND)
        return score + ply;
    return score;
}

const readline = __importStar(require("readline"));
const board_1 = require("../board/board");
const smp_1 = require("../search/smp");
const movegen_1 = require("../move/movegen");
const nnue_1 = require("../eval/nnue");
